body.zh: 波琳·汉森（Pauline Hanson）将澳大利亚原住民称为“地球上最原始的种族”，之后她被猛烈抨击为“彻底的种族主义者”。 这位一国党领导人在一年前接受杰米·J播客采访时发表了上述言论，她批评了学校对原住民历史的研究。 澳大利亚原住民部长马拉迪里·麦卡锡 (Malarndirri McCarthy) 表示，汉森“毫无尊重”。 她周一在议会大厦对记者说：“这完全令人愤慨，完全是种族主义，但它也以我们不希望看到在澳大利亚发生的方式分裂我们的国家。” “我确实相信，作为所有澳大利亚人，我们必须站出来反对这种分裂性的评论……这不是我所认识的澳大利亚。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “这不是我想看到的澳大利亚，我呼吁所有澳大利亚人谴责这种评论。” 独立参议员莉迪亚·索普敦促汉森考虑她的评论可能造成的“真正伤害”。 “我们知道她不会改变。她将继续散布令人讨厌、消息不灵通和有害的想法，以团结她的支持者并分裂这个国家，”她告诉澳大利亚美联社。 索普呼吁总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞“挺身而出”解决种族主义问题。 “宝琳·汉森（Pauline Hanson）在他们（工党）周围四处传播破坏性和分裂性的想法，而本届政府却袖手旁观，”她说。 汉森在过去一周已经受到了批评，此前她发布了一段视频，将自由党议员、前特种部队士兵安德鲁·哈斯蒂称为“叛徒”，并批评阿尔巴尼斯的母亲几十年来一直住在公共住房中。 工党内阁部长坦尼娅·普利伯塞克 (Tanya Plibersek) 在 News24 上表示，汉森愿意“踢倒”的人似乎没有限制，并质疑她对土著文化评论的基础。 “如果你不花时间去了解一种文化，你就没有权利称之为原始文化。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The dignity of every person is a cornerstone of biblical teaching. Leviticus 19:33 calls for treating the foreigner living among you as one of your own native-born. Labeling any group as 'primitive' denies this inherent dignity and fosters division, a stark contrast to the call for equal regard and respect for all.
reflection.zh: 每个人的尊严都是圣经教导的基石。利未记19:33呼吁要待客如本地人。将任何群体称为“原始”都否定了这种固有的尊严，并加剧了分裂，这与呼吁人人享有平等尊重形成鲜明对比。

verse.textEn: When a foreigner resides among you in your land, do not mistreat them. The foreigner residing among you must be treated as your native-born. Love them as yourself, for you were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 若有外人在你们国中和你同居，就不可欺负他。和你们同居的外人，你们要看他如本地人一样，并要爱他如己，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: HA calls for early flu vaccination amid infection rise
title.zh: 医院管理局呼吁尽早接种流感疫苗，因感染人数上升

summary.en: The Hospital Authority (HA) in Hong Kong has reported a significant increase in seasonal flu infections and severe cases, with the virus actively spreading within the community. As the Seasonal Influenza Vaccination Programmes are set to commence on Thursday, the HA will begin administering vaccinations to eligible...
summary.zh: 医院管理局（HA）周二表示，香港季节性流感感染和重症病例激增，病毒正在社区中活跃传播。随着本年度的季节性流感疫苗接种计划将于周四开始，医管局将为定期到公立医院和门诊诊所就诊的合资格病人接种疫苗。家庭医学科的医生表示，病毒活动在冬季可能会更高，因此敦促公众尽快接种疫苗，因为接种后身体需要两周时间才能产生足够的免疫力。

body.en: The Hospital Authority on Tuesday said Hong Kong had seen a surge in seasonal flu infections and serious cases, with the virus actively spreading in the community. With this year’s Seasonal Influenza Vaccination Programmes set to begin on Thursday, the HA will administer jabs to eligible patients who regularly visit public hospitals and outpatient clinics. Speaking at a press conference, associate consultant of the New Territories East Cluster’s department of family medicine, Chan Ting-bong, said viral activity might be even higher in the winter. Therefore, he urged the public to get vaccinated as soon as possible. “After getting vaccinated, our body needs two weeks to produce sufficient antibodies and the immunity can last for at least six months,” Chan said. “If people receive vaccination in September and October, there will be enough time for their bodies to develop antibodies, so that they will have sufficient immunity during Christmas and New Year – a peak time for travel and gatherings. Therefore, getting the jab early is an ideal approach.” Chan also called on pregnant women to get the jab soon, saying the vaccination can not only protect their own health but also safeguard their babies. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 医院管理局周二表示，香港季节性流感感染和重症病例激增，病毒在社区积极传播。今年的季节性流感疫苗计划将于周四开始，医管局将为定期到公立医院和门诊诊所就诊的合资格患者注射疫苗。新界东联网家庭医学部副顾问陈定邦在新闻发布会上表示，冬季病毒活动可能会更高。因此，他呼吁民众尽快接种疫苗。 “接种疫苗后，我们的身体需要两周时间才能产生足够的抗体，免疫力至少可以持续六个月，”陈说。 “如果人们在9月和10月接种疫苗，身体就有足够的时间产生抗体，这样他们在圣诞节和新年这个旅游和聚会的高峰期就有足够的免疫力。因此，尽早接种疫苗是一个理想的方法。”陈女士还呼吁孕妇尽快接种疫苗，不仅可以保护自己的健康，也可以保护宝宝。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: As Hong Kong experiences a surge in flu cases, health authorities are urging prompt vaccination. This proactive approach to community health reminds us of the importance of caring for one another's well-being. The call to get vaccinated is a practical step, akin to the biblical encouragement to seek healing and protection when illness arises.
reflection.zh: 随着香港流感病例激增，卫生部门敦促市民尽快接种疫苗。这种积极主动的社区健康方法提醒我们关怀彼此福祉的重要性。呼吁接种疫苗是一个实际的步骤，如同圣经中鼓励人们在疾病来临时寻求医治和保护一样。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: Hong Kong airport builds third runway with strategy to help marine environment thrive
title.zh: 香港机场修建第三条跑道，助力海洋环境蓬勃发展

summary.en: Hong Kong International Airport (HKIA) is constructing a third runway and associated facilities. The project involves 650 hectares of reclaimed land, with a significant portion built over old mud pits. Engineers are implementing strategies to protect and enhance the surrounding marine environment.
summary.zh: 香港国际机场（HKIA）正在建设第三条跑道及相关设施。该项目涉及650公顷填海土地，其中大部分建在旧泥浆池之上。工程师们正在实施保护和改善周边海洋环境的策略。

body.en: When Hong Kong International Airport (HKIA) set out to build a new runway and associated facilities for the three-runway system operation, engineers had to carefully navigate a challenge hidden beneath the surrounding waters. The project involved 650 hectares (1,606 acres) of reclaimed land adjacent to the existing airport, an area equivalent to about 34 Victoria Parks or 900 standard football pitches. More significantly, some 40 per cent of it sat directly above decades-old mud pits storing...
body.zh: 当香港国际机场 (HKIA) 着手为三跑道系统运营建造一条新跑道和相关设施时，工程师们必须小心应对隐藏在周围水域之下的挑战。该项目涉及现有机场附近 650 公顷（1,606 英亩）的填海土地，面积相当于约 34 个维多利亚公园或 900 个标准足球场。更重要的是，其中约 40% 直接位于已有数十年历史的泥坑之上，这些泥坑储存着……

reflection.en: The construction of a third runway at Hong Kong International Airport presents a complex challenge: balancing infrastructure development with ecological stewardship. The project's commitment to not only minimizing harm but actively fostering marine life demonstrates a thoughtful approach to development. It reminds us that even in ambitious human endeavors,...
reflection.zh: 香港国际机场第三条跑道的建设提出了一个复杂的挑战：在基础设施发展与生态管理之间取得平衡。该项目不仅致力于将损害降至最低，还积极促进海洋生物的繁衍，这体现了一种周到的发展方式。它提醒我们，即使在宏伟的人类事业中，我们也可以寻求与自然世界合作并加以改善，认识到创造中固有的错综复杂的智慧。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Hong Kong visitor arrivals hit post-pandemic monthly high in August
title.zh: 香港8月访港旅客量创后疫情时期月度新高

summary.en: Hong Kong saw its highest monthly visitor numbers since the start of the Covid-19 pandemic in August, reaching 5.46 million. Authorities attribute this surge to a series of international conferences and major events, indicating a strong recovery in the tourism sector.
summary.zh: 香港在8月份迎来了自新冠疫情开始以来的最高月度访港旅客数量，共计546万人次。当局将此激增归因于一系列国际会议和大型活动的举办，显示旅游业强劲复苏。

body.en: Hong Kong recorded its highest monthly number of visitors since the Covid-19 pandemic in August, provisional official figures show, with authorities attributing the surge to a series of international conferences and mega-events. The Hong Kong Tourism Board said on Tuesday that the city received 5.46 million visitors across the month, up by 6 per cent from a year earlier and the highest monthly total since the pandemic. Tourist numbers in the first eight months of the year also rose by 11 per...
body.zh: 临时官方数据显示，香港在 8 月份创下了自 Covid-19 大流行以来的最高月度游客人数，当局将这一激增归因于一系列国际会议和大型活动。香港旅游发展局周二表示，本月香港接待游客 546 万人次，同比增长 6%，为疫情爆发以来的最高月度游客总数。今年前 8 个月的游客人数也增长了 11%...

reflection.en: It is encouraging to see Hong Kong's tourism rebound, with 5.46 million visitors in August, driven by strategic planning for conferences and events. This success reminds us that when we commit our endeavors to Yahweh, He can establish our plans and bring them to fruition, as Proverbs 16:3 suggests.
reflection.zh: 看到香港旅游业的复苏令人鼓舞，8月份访港旅客达到546万人次，这得益于为会议和活动进行的战略规划。这一成功提醒我们，当我们把所做的工作交托给雅伟时，祂就能使我们的计划得以建立并实现，正如箴言16:3所说。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Hong Kong’s employment outlook rebounds sharply to 14% in fourth quarter
title.zh: 香港第四季度就业前景锐减至14%

summary.en: Hong Kong employers' hiring sentiment rebounded sharply in the fourth quarter, with far fewer companies expecting to cut jobs as confidence improved alongside stronger economic growth, according to a ManpowerGroup survey. The international human resources firm said the city’s seasonally adjusted net employment outlook...
summary.zh: 根据ManpowerGroup的一项调查，香港雇主在第四季度的招聘情绪大幅反弹，预计裁员的公司数量大大减少，信心随着经济增长的增强而提高。这家国际人力资源公司表示，该市经季节性调整后的净就业前景升至14%，比今年第三季度的负9%高出23个百分点。

body.en: Hong Kong employers’ hiring sentiment rebounded sharply in the fourth quarter, with far fewer companies expecting to cut jobs as confidence improved alongside stronger economic growth, according to a ManpowerGroup survey. The international human resources firm said the city’s seasonally adjusted net employment outlook rose to 14 per cent, up by 23 percentage points from minus 9 per cent in the third quarter of this year. The outlook is calculated by subtracting the percentage of employers...
body.zh: 万宝盛华集团的一项调查显示，香港雇主的招聘情绪在第四季度大幅反弹，随着信心的改善以及经济增长的强劲，预期裁员的公司大幅减少。这家国际人力资源公司表示，该市经季节性调整的净就业前景升至14%，比今年第三季度的-9%上升了23个百分点。前景是通过减去雇主的百分比来计算的......

reflection.en: As Hong Kong's employment outlook brightens, it's a reminder of the dignity and purpose found in work. Colossians 3:23 encourages us to do all our tasks heartily, as unto Yahweh, finding value not just in the outcome but in the faithful execution of our duties. May this renewed confidence in the job market lead to fulfilling work that honors Yahweh.
reflection.zh: 随着香港就业前景的改善，这提醒我们工作中蕴含的尊严和目标。歌罗西书3章23节鼓励我们凡事甘心，好像是为主做的，不仅要看结果，也要看忠实地履行职责。愿这种对就业市场的信心回升，能带来荣耀雅伟的充实工作。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Roche Experience Days 2026: Shaping the global dialogue on healthcare innovation
title.zh: 罗氏体验日2026：塑造医疗创新全球对话

summary.en: Healthcare professionals and technology innovators are transforming disease detection, management, and treatment by focusing on early detection, high-precision diagnostics, and patient-centered sustainable healthcare systems. Key drivers include AI-driven innovations and other forces reshaping care delivery.
summary.zh: 医疗保健专业人员和技术创新者正在通过关注早期检测、高精度诊断和以患者为中心的、可持续的医疗保健系统，来改变疾病的检测、管理和治疗方式。关键驱动因素包括人工智能驱动的创新以及其他重塑护理交付的力量。

body.en: [The content of this article has been produced by our advertising partner.] Healthcare professionals and technology innovators are transforming how diseases are detected, managed, and treated—shifting the focus from simply treating illnesses after they appear to focus on early detection, high-precision diagnostics, and sustainable healthcare systems that put patients first. At the center of this transformation are four major forces reshaping how care is delivered: AI-Driven Innovations &...
body.zh: [本文的内容由我们的广告合作伙伴制作。] 医疗保健专业人员和技术创新者正在改变疾病的检测、管理和治疗方式，将重点从简单地治疗疾病转向早期检测、高精度诊断和以患者为先的可持续医疗保健系统。这一转变的核心是重塑护理提供方式的四大力量：人工智能驱动的创新和……

reflection.en: The relentless pace of innovation in healthcare, driven by technologies like AI, is a powerful testament to humanity's capacity for discovery and problem-solving. As knowledge expands, may we remember to steward these advancements with wisdom and compassion, ensuring they serve the well-being of all people.
reflection.zh: 医疗保健领域由人工智能等技术驱动的创新步伐永不停歇，这有力地证明了人类发现和解决问题的能力。随着知识的扩展，愿我们铭记以智慧和同情心来管理这些进步，确保它们能服务于所有人的福祉。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: 2 socially isolated brothers found dead in Hong Kong flat, no foul play suspected
title.zh: 香港一公寓内发现两名孤立的兄弟死亡，未发现他杀迹象

summary.en: Two brothers in their fifties, described as socially avoidant and financially dependent on their parents, were found dead in their Hong Kong apartment. Police have stated that no foul play is suspected, and the exact causes of death are pending postmortem examinations. The discovery was made after their elder sister...
summary.zh: 警方称，在香港一间公寓内发现了两名五十多岁的兄弟的遗体。据了解，他们有社交回避倾向，并依靠父母的经济支持。目前未发现他杀迹象，确切死因有待尸检确认。此前，他们的姐姐报案后，警方进行了搜查。

body.en: Two brothers in their fifties have been found dead in their Hong Kong flat, police have said, with a source noting that they had social avoidance tendencies and were financially supported by their parents. The exact causes of death have yet to be confirmed by postmortem examinations. No suspicious circumstances have been identified at this stage, the force said on Tuesday. An insider said the bodies were discovered after the men’s elder sister made a police report on Monday. The sister was...
body.zh: 警方称，两名五十多岁的兄弟被发现死在香港的公寓里，消息人士指出，他们有社交回避倾向，并由父母提供经济支持。确切的死亡原因还有待尸检证实。警方周二表示，现阶段尚未发现可疑情况。一位知情人士称，这些尸体是在这两名男子的姐姐周一向警方报案后发现的。姐姐原来是...

reflection.en: This news from Hong Kong is a somber reminder of the deep isolation that can afflict individuals, even within family structures. The brothers' situation, marked by social avoidance and dependence, evokes the Psalmist's cry, "Do not cast me off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength is spent." It calls us to greater awareness and compassion...
reflection.zh: 香港的这则新闻令人深思，它提醒我们，即使在家庭结构中，个体也可能遭受深刻的孤立。这两兄弟的处境，以社交回避和依赖为特征，令人想起诗篇作者的呼求：“年老的时候，求你不要丢弃我；我力气衰弱的时候，求你不要离弃我。”这促使我们对社会边缘人群给予更多的关注和同情，确保没有人孤单地走向生命的终点。

verse.textEn: Do not cast me away when I am old; do not forsake me when my strength is gone.
verse.textZh: 我年老的时候，求你不要丢弃我；我力气衰弱的时候，求你不要离弃我。

title.en: Visitor arrivals surge 6pc to 5.46m in August
title.zh: 八月访港旅客飙升6%至546万

summary.en: Visitor arrivals in Hong Kong reached 5.46 million in August, the highest monthly figure since the COVID-19 pandemic, marking a 6% year-on-year increase. The Tourism Board attributed this growth to major international events, conferences, exhibitions, and mega events like the Hong Kong Football Festival, which...
summary.zh: 香港旅游业在8月份迎来了546万访港旅客，创下自新冠疫情以来的最高月度纪录，同比增长6%。旅发局将此增长归因于多项大型国际会议、奖励旅游、展览及盛事，例如吸引了多元化旅客并带动中国内地、新加坡及英国等客源市场的香港足球嘉年华。长途市场的访客人数增幅最大，达到18%。

body.en: The Tourism Board on Tuesday said visitor arrivals reached 5.46 million in August, making it the highest monthly figure since the Covid pandemic. The figure, a provisional one, represented a year-on-year increase of six percent. The board attributed the growth to a number of major international meetings, incentives, conferences and exhibitions as well as mega events staged in the SAR. These included the Hong Kong Football Festival, which “attracted a diverse range of visitors and helped drive visitor arrivals from the Chinese mainland, Singapore, the United Kingdom and other source markets”. The number of visits by tourists from long-haul markets recorded the greatest increase of 18 percent to about 289,490. In the first eight months of the year, total tourist figures hit 36.67 million, up 11 percent from a year ago. “Among these, the Chinese mainland and long-haul markets maintained stable overall performance,” the board said in a statement. “Visitor growth in short-haul markets continued to face challenges owing to factors such as flight capacity, fuel surcharges and regional competition.” Short-haul visits slipped four percent to about four million. Looking ahead, the board said it would step up promotions for upcoming festivals such as the Mid-Autumn Festival and Halloween as well as expand the scale of flagship mega events to lure visitors. It would also continue to work with the tourism and business sectors to promote experiences exclusive to Hong Kong, attract more high-value-added overnight travellers and boost the economy. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 旅游局周二表示，8 月份入境游客人数达到 546 万人次，这是自新冠疫情大流行以来的最高月度数字。该数字是临时数字，同比增长百分之六。董事会将增长归因于一系列大型国际会议、奖励旅游、大会和展览以及在特区举办的大型活动。其中包括香港足球节，它“吸引了不同类型的游客，并有助于推动来自中国大陆、新加坡、英国和其他客源市场的游客”。来自长途市场的游客人数增幅最大，达18%，达到约289,490人次。今年前8个月，全国接待游客3667万人次，同比增长11%。 “其中，中国内地及长途市场整体表现保持稳定，”董事会在一份声明中表示。 “由于航班运力、燃油附加费和区域竞争等因素，短途市场的旅客增长继续面临挑战。”短途旅行人数下降了 4%，至约 400 万人次。展望未来，该局表示将加大中秋节、万圣节等节日的促销力度，并扩大旗舰大型活动的规模以吸引游客。特区政府亦会继续与旅游及商界合作，推广香港独有的体验，吸引更多高增值过夜旅客，提振经济。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: As Hong Kong celebrates a surge in visitor numbers, reaching its highest monthly figure since the pandemic, it's a moment to acknowledge the fruits of planning and effort. This economic uptick, driven by events and attractions, reminds us that prosperity often follows diligent work and strategic investment. Yet, it also calls us to remember the ultimate...
reflection.zh: 香港庆祝访港旅客人数激增，创下疫情以来的最高月度纪录，这是肯定规划和努力成果的时刻。经济的增长得益于各项活动和景点，提醒我们繁荣往往是勤奋工作和战略投资的结果。然而，这也促使我们反思一切美好事物的最终来源，并为促成这种增长的机会和资源献上感恩。

verse.textEn: Remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth.
verse.textZh: 你要记念雅伟你的神，因为得货财的力量是他给你的。

title.en: Flat-selection ballot held for Wang Fuk Court owners
title.zh: 王福苑业主举行选楼次序抽签

summary.en: The ballot to determine the flat-selection order for owners of Wang Fuk Court, who are seeking new homes under the government's Special Sales Exercise, was held on Tuesday morning. The first 10 numbers drawn for the initial batch of applicants were 25, 28, 75, 12, 56, 99, 59, 64, 36, and 47. Official results are...
summary.zh: 为响应政府的“特别销售计划”，王福苑业主昨日上午举行了决定选楼次序的抽签。首批申请者抽出的前10个号码依次是25、28、75、12、56、99、59、64、36和47。官方结果预计下午3时左右在其计划网站公布。根据该计划，选楼次序按业主签署的“接纳信”递交日期分批决定，首批截止日期为6月30日，第二批为8月31日。每批...

body.en: The ballot to determine flat-selection order for Wang Fuk Court owners seeking new homes under the government’s Special Sales Exercise was held Tuesday morning. For the first batch of applicants, the first 10 numbers drawn, in order, were 25, 28, 75, 12, 56, 99, 59, 64, 36 and 47. Official results are scheduled to be uploaded to the scheme website at about 3pm. Under the exercise, selection order is decided in batches according to the date the government received an owner’s signed "Letter of Acceptance". The first-batch deadline was June 30, and the second-batch deadline was August 31. Within each batch, applicants are ordered by a computer ballot based on the last two digits of their application number. The government has reserved more than 4,400 units across 10 Housing Authority and Housing Society developments for owners who have sold their Wang Fuk Court units to the government, allowing them to buy a new subsidised unit or exchange flat-for-flat. The estates are located in various areas including Kowloon Bay, Kai Tak, Tseung Kwan O, Kwun Tong and Tai Po, with prices ranging from more than HK$1.5 million to over HK$5.3 million. Unit selection is expected to begin this month. An owner, surnamed Cheung, said the fire left her unit completely destroyed, and she hoped to be rehoused as soon as possible. Her selection number is among the first 30, so she believes she will be able to choose a unit in Kowloon Bay and move in before the end of the year. In a social media post, Secretary for Housing Winnie Ho said her bureau would send letters in batches according to the flat-selection order. The letters will notify applicants of their place in the queue and invite eligible applicants to attend a flat-selection session at the Green Form Subsidised Home Ownership Scheme Sales Unit in Kwun Tong at a designated date and time. Ho added that the bureau’s engagement team is continuing to arrange flat-viewing tours to help owners better understand the scheme. As of Monday, Ho said the government had signed agreements for sale and purchase with 1,702 households — about 85.8 percent of owners across the eight blocks of Wang Fuk Court. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 周二上午，针对政府特别销售活动中寻找新房的宏福苑业主进行了投票，以确定其选楼顺序。第一批申请者中，前10个号码依次为25、28、75、12、56、99、59、64、36和47。正式结果预计于下午3点左右上传到计划网站。此次活动中，根据政府收到业主签署的“中标函”的日期，分批决定遴选顺序。第一批截止日期为6月30日，第二批截止日期为8月31日。在每批中，申请人根据申请号的最后两位数字通过电脑抽签进行排序。政府已在房委会及房屋协会的10个发展项目中预留超过4,400个单位，供已将宏福苑单位出售给政府的业主购买新的资助单位或以换楼。屋苑分布于九龙湾、启德、将军澳、观塘及大埔等地区，售价由超过150万港元至超过530万港元不等。单位选择预计将于本月开始。一位姓张的业主表示，火灾使她的单位完全被毁，她希望尽快重新安置。她的选号是前30名，相信年底前就能在九龙湾选到单位入住。房屋局局长何温妮在社交媒体发帖表示，房屋局将根据选楼顺序分批发信。该信函会通知申请者其轮候顺序，并邀请合资格申请者于指定日期及时间前往观塘绿表置业销售单位参加选楼会。何补充说，该局的参与团队正继续安排看楼之旅，以帮助业主更好地了解该计划。何先生表示，截至周一，政府已与 1,702 户家庭签署了买卖协议，约占宏福苑 8 个街区业主的 85.8%。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: Today's news describes a lottery for housing selection, a process that requires careful planning and execution by both the government and the applicants. For those involved, whether as organizers or participants, committing their efforts and plans to Yahweh can bring peace and assurance. May all endeavors, from major housing projects to individual...
reflection.zh: 今日新闻报道了住房选址的抽签过程，这需要政府和申请人双方的精心策划与执行。对于所有参与者而言，无论是组织者还是申请人，将他们的努力和计划交托给雅伟，都能带来平安和确据。愿所有事业，从大型住房项目到个人抱负，都能在神的智慧引导下，达成公正有序的结果。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Hong Kong’s MTR Corp announces half-price fares for ‘Thank You Day’ on October 24
title.zh: 香港地铁公司宣布10月24日“感谢日”票价半折

summary.en: Hong Kong's rail operator, MTR Corporation, will offer half-price fares on October 24 as part of a "Thank You Day" promotion. This discount will apply to railway, light rail, and bus services for users of Octopus and JoyYou cards, as well as QR code ticket holders on the heavy rail network, including cross-border...
summary.zh: 香港铁路运营商港铁公司将于10月24日推出“感谢日”推广活动，提供半价票价优惠。此折扣将适用于铁路、轻铁及巴士服务，适用于使用八达通及“港铁通”的用户，以及港铁重铁网络的二维码车票持有人，包括跨境旅程。

body.en: Hong Kong’s rail operator will offer half-price fares across its network on October 24, as part of a “Thank You Day” promotion. The MTR Corporation said discounts would apply to Octopus and JoyYou card users on its railway, light rail and bus services in the northwestern New Territories, as well as to QR code ticket holders on the heavy rail network. Cross-border journeys to and from Lo Wu and Lok Ma Chau stations on the East Rail line will also be covered. Passengers can combine the half-price...
body.zh: 作为“感谢日”促销活动的一部分，香港铁路运营商将于 10 月 24 日在其网络上提供半价票价。港铁公司表示，八达通和JoyYou卡用户在新界西北部的铁路、轻铁和巴士服务以及重铁网络上的二维码车票持有者将享受折扣。往返东铁线罗湖站和落马洲站的跨境旅程亦将涵盖。乘客可以结合半价...

reflection.en: The MTR Corporation's "Thank You Day" is a gesture of appreciation for its customers. It reflects a thoughtful approach to public service, where planned acts of generosity can foster goodwill and acknowledge the community's support. Such initiatives, when undertaken with diligence and care, can strengthen the relationship between service providers and the...
reflection.zh: 港铁公司举办的“感谢日”活动是对其客户表达谢意的一种方式。它体现了一种周到的公共服务方式，通过有计划的慷慨之举可以培养良好关系，并感谢社区的支持。这些举措若以勤勉和关怀来执行，可以加强服务提供者与其所服务公众之间的联系。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: 'Preparatory work underway for Golden Week holiday'
title.zh: 黄金周假期准备工作正在进行中

summary.en: Hong Kong's Chief Executive John Lee stated on Tuesday that preparations are being made to ensure a pleasant experience for travelers during the upcoming National Day Golden Week holiday. He mentioned that a trial real-name reservation scheme for crowd management at Po Pin Chau trail was successful and anticipates...
summary.zh: 香港特首李家超周二表示，为确保即将到来的国庆黄金周假期期间前往香港的旅客能有愉快的体验，相关准备工作正在进行中。他提到，在西贡东郊野公园海下湾海岸公园试行的实名预约制人群管理措施在上周末运行顺利，预计假期期间将有更多游客。渔农自然护理署也将增派人手，提醒游客保护环境、妥善处理垃圾并维持秩序。

body.en: Chief Executive John Lee on Tuesday said preparatory work is underway to ensure that travellers heading to the SAR during the upcoming National Day Golden Week holiday next month would have a pleasant experience. Speaking ahead of the Executive Council meeting, Lee noted that a real-name reservation trial scheme – a crowd management measure – that was adopted at the Po Pin Chau trail in Sai Kung East Country Park went smoothly over the first weekend. He expects more people will set foot there during the holiday. "The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department will also step up manpower to remind visitors to protect the environment, dispose of their waste properly, and keep order," he said. "And since many visitors will be using the registration system for the first time, we'll be there to assist them." Meanwhile, the Travel Industry Authority last week revoked the licences of two travel agencies and a tour guide over forced shopping – the third such enforcement action so far this year. The CE said the government would crack down on any misconduct by agencies, tour guides, as well as shops, given that this kind of misbehaviour would damage the reputation of Hong Kong’s tourism sector. The registration of those will also be cancelled if violations are found, he stressed. Lee called on society to adopt a welcoming and courteous attitude to tourists, saying that the period is crucial for the tourism industry as well as an opportunity for the city to showcase its hospitality. He said in addition to the Tourism Board’s website dedicated for the holiday period, the government would step up information dissemination, including on boundary crossings, the waiting time and opening hours of popular tourist attractions and transportation arrangements. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 行政长官李家超周二表示，准备工作正在进行中，以确保下个月即将到来的国庆黄金周假期前往特区的旅客能够有一个愉快的经历。李在行政会议前发言时表示，西贡东郊野公园破边洲径采用的实名预约试验计划（一项人流管理措施）在首个周末进展顺利。他预计假期期间会有更多人踏足那里。他说：“渔农自然护理署亦会加强人手，提醒旅客保护环境、妥善处置废物及维持秩序。” “由于许多参观者将是第一次使用注册系统，我们将在那里为他们提供帮助。”与此同时，旅游业管理局上周因强迫购物吊销了两家旅行社和一名导游的执照，这是今年迄今为止的第三起此类执法行动。行政长官表示，政府会严厉打击旅行社、导游和商店的不当行为，因为这种不当行为会损害香港旅游业的声誉。他强调，如果发现违规行为，这些人的注册也将被取消。李呼吁社会对游客采取欢迎和礼貌的态度，并表示这段时期对旅游业至关重要，也是香港展示热情好客的机会。他表示，除了旅游局专门针对假期期间推出的网站外，政府会加强信息发布，包括过境信息、热门旅游景点的轮候时间和开放时间以及交通安排。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: As Hong Kong prepares to welcome visitors for the Golden Week holiday, Chief Executive John Lee highlighted the importance of planning and crowd management. This focus on preparation echoes the wisdom found in Proverbs 16:3, which encourages us to commit our plans to Yahweh. May all efforts to ensure a smooth and enjoyable experience for travelers be guided...
reflection.zh: 随着香港为迎接黄金周假期而做准备，迎接游客的到来，行政长官李家超强调了规划和人群管理的重要性。这种对准备工作的关注呼应了《箴言》16:3 所蕴含的智慧，鼓励我们将计划交托给雅伟。愿所有为确保旅客获得顺畅愉快体验的努力，都能蒙受神圣的智慧引导，并取得圆满成功。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: CE vows accountability over hospital lift failure
title.zh: 行政长官誓言追究医院电梯故障责任

summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee stated on Tuesday that those responsible for the malfunctioning lifts at Queen Mary Hospital's new clinical block would be held accountable. The lift issues have postponed the commencement of clinical services in the new building. Lee indicated that a thorough investigation would be conducted,...
summary.zh: 行政长官李家超周二表示，将追究玛丽医院新临床大楼电梯故障的责任人。电梯问题已导致新大楼的临床服务推迟启用。李家超表示，已要求发展局在一个月内彻底调查此事并提交报告，追究承建商、分包商、工程人员及专业人士的责任，若有政府人员涉事，亦会追究其责任。

body.en: Chief Executive John Lee said on Tuesday those responsible for faulty lifts at Queen Mary Hospital’s new clinical block would be held accountable. The problems with the lifts had delayed the launch of clinical services at the new building. Speaking before the weekly Executive Council meeting, Lee said he had asked the Development Bureau to thoroughly investigate the matter and report back within a month. “We will pursue accountability, including contractor, subcontractors, engineering personnel and professionals,” he said. “And if there are government personnel involved, we will pursue their accountability as well. “We also need to identify where and whether the system has any inadequacies and rectify them.” Lee also said the problems with the lifts must be quickly addressed. He stressed the importance of medical services, saying the new clinical block must be opened up to enable the provision of services as soon as possible. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 行政长官李约翰周二表示，那些对玛丽医院新临床区电梯故障负责的人将被追究责任。电梯问题推迟了新大楼临床服务的启动。李在行政会议每周例会前表示，他已要求发展局彻底调查此事，并在一个月内报告。 “我们将追究责任，包括承包商、分包商、工程人员和专业人员，”他说。 “如果有政府人员参与，我们也会追究他们的责任。我们还需要查明制度在哪里、是否有不足之处，并予以纠正。”李还表示，电梯的问题必须迅速解决。他强调了医疗服务的重要性，并表示必须开放新的临床区，以便尽快提供服务。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: When public infrastructure fails, especially in a hospital setting, the impact on patients and staff is immediate and significant. The Chief Executive's commitment to accountability, from contractors to government officials, reflects a crucial principle: those entrusted with public service must answer for their stewardship. This pursuit of justice ensures...
reflection.zh: 当公共设施出现故障，尤其是在医院环境中，对病人和工作人员的影响是直接而重大的。行政长官对从承包商到政府官员追究责任的承诺，体现了一个关键原则：那些被委托承担公共服务的人必须对其管理负责。这种对公正的追求有助于纠正系统性问题并重建信任。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: First 5-year plan to lay out grand vision for HK: CE
title.zh: 首份五年规划勾勒香港宏伟愿景：行政长官

summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee announced that Hong Kong's inaugural five-year plan will outline the city's strategic direction and long-term vision. The plan, symbolized by a blue cover representing openness, progress, and stability, aims to drive reforms, foster opportunities, and ensure equitable distribution of economic...
summary.zh: 行政长官李家超表示，香港的首份五年规划将勾勒出城市的整体方向和长远愿景。该规划以象征开放、进步和稳定的蓝色封面呈现，旨在推动改革、创造机遇，并确保经济惠益的公平分享。规划将于周三与年度施政报告一同发布。

body.en: Chief Executive John Lee said the city's first five-year plan would set out Hong Kong’s overall direction and long-term vision, adding that authorities would push reforms, create opportunities and ensure that everyone shares in the economic benefits. Lee will deliver both the five-year plan and the annual Policy Address on Wednesday. Speaking to reporters ahead of his weekly Executive Council meeting on Tuesday, Lee said the five-year plan would have a blue cover to symbolise openness, progress and stability, while the Policy Address would retain its green cover to represent continuity, vitality and hope. "The five-year plan is not a planned economy. It is a plan which tells us where the strategic directions are, where we are heading and which are the priority areas," he said. "And then It is a blueprint for us to implement in five years' time, so when we each year roll out policies, then we also have to ascertain priorities so that at the end of five years, we will reach certain goals." A special booklet featuring highlights of both documents would also be released, Lee added, to help the public better understand their contents. Its cover shows Victoria Harbour in the morning light and blends the colours of the two document covers. After presenting the two documents, he will also take part in a press conference, a television forum, radio shows and an interactive question-and-answer session at the Legislative Council to explain their contents in detail. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 行政长官李家超表示，香港第一个五年规划将阐明香港的总体方向和长远愿景，并补充说，当局将推动改革，创造机会，确保所有人分享经济利益。李显龙将于周三发表五年计划和年度施政报告。李在周二的行政会议每周例会前对记者表示，五年计划的封面将采用蓝色，象征开放、进步和稳定，而施政报告将保留绿色封面，象征连续性、活力和希望。 “五年计划不是计划经济。它是一个告诉我们战略方向在哪里、我们要去哪里、哪些是优先领域的计划，”他说。 “然后它是我们五年后实施的蓝图，所以我们每年推出政策时，也要确定优先事项，以便在五年结束时，我们能够达到一定的目标。”李补充说，还将发行一本特别小册子，其中介绍了这两份文件的要点，以帮助公众更好地了解其内容。它的封面展示了晨光中的维多利亚港，并融合了两个文件封面的颜色。提交两份文件后，他亦会出席立法会的记者会、电视论坛、电台节目及互动问答环节，详细解释文件内容。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: The Chief Executive's presentation of Hong Kong's first five-year plan signifies a deliberate effort to chart a course for the future, focusing on reforms and shared prosperity. This endeavor echoes the wisdom of committing one's plans to a higher power, trusting that guidance and success ultimately come from above. May the leaders involved seek wisdom and...
reflection.zh: 行政长官提出香港首份五年规划，标志着一项为未来指明方向的审慎努力，重点关注改革和共同繁荣。这一举措呼应了将计划交托于更高力量的智慧，相信指引和成功最终来自上天。愿参与其中的领导者寻求智慧和正直，在规划愿景时，确保其服务于共同利益，并体现对所有居民的公正和福祉的承诺。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Tiananmen Square vigil organisers jailed for seven years in Hong Kong
title.zh: 香港国安法下，支联会前正副主席煽动颠覆罪成判囚七年

summary.en: Hong Kong activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan have been sentenced to seven years in prison after being found guilty of inciting subversion under the city's national security law for their roles in organizing an annual vigil commemorating the Tiananmen Square massacre.
summary.zh: 香港活动人士周庭栋和李卓人因在组织纪念天安门事件的年度集会中煽动颠覆国家政权，根据香港国安法被判处七年监禁。

body.en: Pro-democracy activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan were found guilty of ‘incitement to subversion’ in controversial national security case Two pro-democracy activists who were put on trial for organising an annual Tiananmen Square massacre vigil in Hong Kong have been sentenced to seven years in jail, in one of the city’s most significant national security cases. Chow Hang-tung, 41 and Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, were found guilty in August of incitement to subversion . The court found they had “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 民主活动人士周恒东和李卓人在有争议的国家安全案件中被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。两名因在香港组织一年一度的天安门广场大屠杀守夜活动而受审的民主活动人士被判处七年监禁，这是香港最重大的国家安全案件之一。 41 岁的周恒东和 69 岁的李卓人于 8 月被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。法院认为，他们“煽动他人以非法手段组织、策划、实施或者参与颠覆国家政权的行为”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The sentencing of Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan highlights a profound tension between civic duty and conscience. Their conviction for organizing a Tiananmen Square vigil raises questions about the limits of free expression and assembly when they are perceived to challenge state power. The principle of obeying God over human authorities, even when it...
reflection.zh: 周庭栋和李卓人的判刑凸显了公民责任与良知之间的深刻张力。他们因组织天安门事件悼念集会被定罪，引发了关于言论和集会自由界限的疑问，尤其是在这些自由被视为挑战国家权力之时。即使面临世俗的惩罚，也要优先顺服雅伟而非人间的命令，这一原则在这样的处境中引起了深刻共鸣。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Wall Street Journal publisher convicted in Hong Kong of deterring reporter from union role
title.zh: 《华尔街日报》出版商在香港被判犯有阻止记者担任工会职务的罪名

summary.en: Dow Jones, the publisher of The Wall Street Journal, has been convicted in a Hong Kong court of one count of deterring reporter Selina Cheng from taking up a role at the Hong Kong Journalist Association. The case raised concerns about press freedom in the city, as Cheng was dismissed weeks after her appointment as...
summary.zh: 《华尔街日报》的出版商道琼斯公司在香港一家法院被判犯有一项阻止记者郑丽莎担任香港记者协会职务的罪名。此案引发了对该市新闻自由的担忧，郑女士在2024年被任命为香港记协主席数周后被公司以重组为由解雇。

body.en: Dow Jones convicted of one count of deterring Selina Cheng from role at Hong Kong Journalist Association but cleared of second charge A Hong Kong court has convicted the publisher of the Wall Street Journal of deterring a reporter from taking up a trade union role, in a case that raised concerns about press freedom in the city. The newspaper dismissed Selina Cheng just weeks after she was appointed chair of the Hong Kong Journalist Association (HKJA) in 2024. She was told at the time her termination was officially due to restructuring. Continue reading...
body.zh: 道琼斯因一项阻止郑秀玲在香港记者协会任职的罪名被定罪，但第二项指控被洗清。香港一家法院判定《华尔街日报》出版商阻止一名记者担任工会职务的罪名成立，此案引起了人们对香港新闻自由的担忧。该报在 2024 年被任命为香港记者协会 (HKJA) 主席几周后解雇了郑嘉颖。当时她被告知，她的解雇正式是由于重组。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of Dow Jones in Hong Kong for deterring a reporter from union activity underscores a troubling trend where corporate actions can stifle worker advocacy. The prophet Micah reminds us that true righteousness involves acting justly and loving mercy, even in the face of corporate restructuring or perceived inconvenience. May we pray for leaders...
reflection.zh: 道琼斯公司在香港被判阻止记者参与工会活动，这凸显了一个令人担忧的趋势：企业行为可能扼杀工人维权。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义在于秉行公义，喜爱怜悯，即使面对企业重组或所谓的“不便”。愿我们为媒体和商业界的领导者祈祷，愿他们坚守这些原则，确保追求利润不会掩盖员工的基本权利和尊严。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Unidentified Murder review – playful sendup of alien abduction and true crime influencers in Hong Kong
title.zh: 无名凶案评论——香港外星人绑架和真实犯罪网红的戏谑之作

summary.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling. Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done...
summary.zh: 童年好友声称目睹了一名学童的失踪，这是一部低成本的喜剧冒险片，挑战了叙事的极限。由郭嘉熙和李振杰执导的这部规模不大但结构精巧的喜剧，以一种随心所欲的戏谑方式讽刺了真实犯罪爱好者和伪网红，但带着喜爱而非恶意。影片围绕一个（虚构的）25年前的案件展开，这个案件吸引了整个香港的关注。当他们七岁时，童年好友马克（凌文龙饰）和基...

body.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done with affection rather than malice. It revolves around a (fictional) 25-year-old case that captivates the whole of Hong Kong. Back when they were seven, childhood friends Mark (Ling Man-lung) and Kit (Ronald Lam Tsz-kit) claimed to have witnessed the abduction by aliens of their classmate Ho in the woods of Tung Tau Hill. On the 25th anniversary of this supposed incident, the pair re-enter the internet’s consciousness after an interview on an online chatshow about unsolved mysteries. Cashing in on their viral fame, Mark’s girlfriend Man (Renci Yeung) hires actor Kim (Peter Chan Charm-man) to pretend to be Ho, all in the hope of racking up views on her social channels. Just when the cameras are all set up, Man watches in horror as the staged reunion leads to a real murder … or does it? The film unfolds in a series of increasingly tricksy complications and reversals. All of a sudden, apparent victims are revealed to be scheming masterminds, and vice versa. As most of the actions take place in the forest where the abduction supposedly occurred, the plot derives comic relief from the increasingly blurred line between truth and playacting. Largely shot with handheld cameras, it has a visual style that lends authenticity to representations of online media, though occasionally this distracts from the physical comedy performed by the cast. The constant twists also turn into bit of a competitive sport, meaning the film becomes more of a writing exercise than anything else. Continue reading...
body.zh: 儿时的朋友声称在这部低成本喜剧中目睹了一名小学生的失踪，这部喜剧突破了讲故事的极限。郭家熙和李俊杰的这部喜剧规模适中，结构复杂，是对真正的犯罪爱好者和想要成为影响者的反复无常的讽刺，是出于感情而不是恶意。它围绕着一个（虚构的）25 年前震惊整个香港的案件展开。七岁时，青梅竹马的Mark（凌文龙饰）和Kit（林中基饰）声称在东头山的树林里亲眼目睹了同学何氏被外星人绑架。在这起所谓的事件发生 25 周年之际，两人在一次关于未解之谜的在线访谈节目中接受采访后，重新进入了互联网的视野。马克的女友曼（杨仁慈饰）利用他们的病毒名气，聘请演员金（陈可辛饰）假扮何浩，希望能在她的社交频道上获得更多的关注。就在摄像机全部架好时，曼惊恐地看着这场上演的重聚导致了一场真正的谋杀……真的是这样吗？影片以一系列日益棘手的复杂情况和逆转展开。突然之间，表面上的受害者被揭露为诡计多端的策划者，反之亦然。由于大部分情节都发生在据称发生绑架的森林中，因此事实与表演之间的界限越来越模糊，情节因此而变得喜剧化。它主要是用手持摄像机拍摄的，其视觉风格为在线媒体的表现提供了真实性，尽管有时这会分散演员们表演的肢体喜剧的注意力。不断的曲折也变成了一种竞技运动，这意味着这部电影更像是一种写作练习。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This film playfully explores how a compelling, albeit fictional, mystery can capture a community's imagination for decades. It reminds us that stories, especially those presented as "true crime," can take on a life of their own, shaping perception and discussion. Proverbs 18:17 cautions that the first to speak in a dispute seems right, until the other side...
reflection.zh: 这部电影以一种戏谑的方式探讨了一个引人入胜的、尽管是虚构的谜团，如何能长达数十年地抓住一个社区的想象力。它提醒我们，故事，尤其是那些被呈现为“真实犯罪”的故事，可以拥有自己的生命，塑造人们的看法和讨论。箴言18:17警示说，在争论中先开口的人似乎有理，直到另一方被听到，这一原则即使在“争论”是一个年代久远、可能被想象出来的事件时也同样适用。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in second national security case
title.zh: 香港民主派活动人士黄之锋承认在第二起国安案中认罪

Continue reading...

This situation echoes the early apostles' declaration: "We...
reflection.zh: 黄之锋已承认香港国安法下的指控，面临可能被判处无期徒刑。他被指控寻求外国制裁的行为，使他处于一个艰难的境地，即遵守国家法律与他根深蒂固的民主和自由信念相冲突。这种情况呼应了早期使徒的宣告：“顺从神，过于顺从人。”

title.en: Responsibilities in close social relationships explain Eastern–Western cultural differences
title.zh: 亲密社会关系中的责任解释了东西方文化差异

summary.en: A study suggests that cultural differences between Eastern and Western societies, often categorized as interdependent and independent, can be understood by examining how people perceive their responsibilities within close social relationships. This challenges previous assumptions about the fundamental definitions of...
summary.zh: 一项研究表明，东西方社会之间通常被归类为相互依赖和独立的文化差异，可以通过考察人们如何看待其在亲密社会关系中的责任来理解。这挑战了先前关于这些文化类型基本定义的假设。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Do you think that a person who reorganizes their life so that their aging parents can live with them would be likely to push another out of the way on the subway? What about greeting strangers with a smile? The answers to these questions are at the heart of a puzzle social psychologists have been debating for 30 years: how to best understand differences among cultures.

Cultures are generally classified as interdependent or independent, and the prevailing idea that defines cultural differences is whether people value the group more than the individual, a concept called collectivism. For decades, the surveys that social psychologists used to measure collectivism have generated contradictory and nonsensical findings, such as repeatedly labeling Western cultures, such as the United States and United Kingdom, as more interdependent than East Asian countries, such as Japan.

In a study published in Nature Human Behavior on Sept. 15, an international research team showed that the responsibilities people hold in close relationships reliably differentiate Eastern and Western cultures and form the foundation of collectivism. The researchers developed a survey to measure this phenomenon, which they termed responsibilism.

"Culture is everywhere, and because it is everywhere, understanding it unlocks opportunities all around us," said Thomas Talhelm, lead author of the study and the new Robert Cialdini Endowed Professor in Social Influence in the Arizona State University Department of Psychology.

"This work on responsibilism has the potential to give insight to people who straddle cultures, including children of immigrants navigating conflicting expectations at home and in school, teachers who adjust their instruction based on students with different value sets, or doctors who have to help people make decisions for sick family members."

Talhelm spent seven years living in China, which inspired and shaped this work. While living in Beijing, he experienced competitive jostling on the subway and received suspicious frowns when he smiled at people he passed on the street.

At first, these behaviors seemed inconsistent with China having a collectivist culture—until he realized the common thread running through all these interactions was that they were between people who did not have close relationships with each other. Talhelm thought this thread might be contributing to contradictory findings about collectivism.

To test this idea, the research team set up new survey questions to drill down into the responsibilities that come with having a close relationship with someone. The...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 你认为一个人为了年迈的父母能和他们住在一起而重新安排自己的生活，会不会在地铁上把另一个人推开？跟陌生人打招呼怎么样？这些问题的答案是社会心理学家争论了 30 年的一个难题的核心：如何最好地理解文化之间的差异。 文化通常被分为相互依赖或独立，定义文化差异的流行观念是人们是否更重视群体而不是个人，这个概念称为集体主义。几十年来，社会心理学家用来衡量集体主义的调查产生了相互矛盾和荒谬的发现，例如反复给美国和英国等西方文化贴上比日本等东亚国家更加相互依存的标签。 9月15日，国际研究小组在《自然·人类行为》杂志上发表的一项研究表明，人们在亲密关系中所承担的责任可靠地区分了东西方文化，并构成了集体主义的基础。研究人员开展了一项调查来衡量这种现象，他们称之为责任主义。 该研究的主要作者、亚利桑那州立大学心理学系社会影响力教授托马斯·塔尔赫姆 (Thomas Talhelm) 表示：“文化无处不在，而且正因为它无处不在，了解它可以为我们周围的人带来机遇。” “这项关于责任主义的工作有可能为跨文化的人们提供洞察力，包括在家庭和学校中面临相互冲突的期望的移民儿童、根据具有不同价值观的学生调整教学的教师，或者必须帮助人们为生病的家庭成员做出决定的医生。” 塔赫姆在中国生活了七年，这激发并塑造了这部作品。在北京生活期间，他在地铁上经历了竞争性的推挤，当他在街上对路过的人微笑时，别人会皱起眉头。 起初，这些行为似乎与中国的集体主义文化不一致——直到他意识到贯穿所有这些互动的共同点是，这些互动是在彼此关系不密切的人之间进行的。塔尔赫姆认为这条线索可能会导致关于集体主义的矛盾发现。 为了验证这个想法，研究团队设置了新的调查问题，以深入探讨与某人建立密切关系所带来的责任。这...

reflection.en: The research highlights how different cultures prioritize responsibilities within relationships, leading to distinct social behaviors. This echoes the profound truth that every person, regardless of cultural background, is created in the image of Yahweh. This shared divine image calls us to recognize the inherent dignity and interconnectedness of all...
reflection.zh: 这项研究强调了不同文化如何优先考虑人际关系中的责任，从而导致不同的社会行为。这呼应了一个深刻的真理：每个人，无论其文化背景如何，都是照着雅伟的形象所造。这共同的神圣形象呼召我们认识到所有人的内在尊严和相互联系，超越文化鸿沟。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: Indigenous Australian population was much larger than previously thought and decimated after First Fleet's arrival
title.zh: 澳大利亚原住民人口远超此前估计，并在首批船抵达后遭到毁灭性打击

summary.en: New research indicates that Australia's Indigenous population before European arrival was significantly larger than previously understood. The study also reveals a much greater population decline due to colonization, estimating that 93% of the pre-European population was lost within 80 years of the First Fleet's...
summary.zh: 一项新研究表明，欧洲人抵达前澳大利亚的原住民人口数量远超此前的估计。该研究还显示，殖民化导致的人口损失比先前认为的要大得多，估计在1788年首批船抵达后的不到80年内，原住民人口损失了93%。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Australia had a much larger Indigenous population before the arrival of Europeans than previously thought, according to new research. The research also demonstrates much larger population losses resulting from colonization than previously believed, with an estimated 93% of the pre-European population lost in less than 80 years following the 1788 arrival of the First Fleet.

Professor Corey Bradshaw, Flinders University Global Ecology Professor and a chief investigator in the Australian Research Council Centre of Excellence for Indigenous and Environmental Histories and Futures (CIEHF), is part of a national research group working with Indigenous partners to investigate Indigenous population sizes over time.

Using sophisticated computer modeling, they calculated that the Indigenous population was up to seven times larger than previously estimated.

"Understanding the size of Indigenous populations in Australia before European invasion in 1788 is essential to truth-telling and reconciliation," says Professor Bradshaw.

The research team arrived at new population estimates by reviewing ethnographic observations, archaeological and genetic reconstructions, and modeling environmental carrying capacity across the continent to estimate the Indigenous population size before colonization.

Many previous estimates are anchored by one of the earliest attempts to determine pre-colonization populations by anthropologist Alfred Radcliffe-Brown in the 1930s, who calculated a population of 250,000 people.

However, he acknowledged these values did not account for the impacts of lethal diseases and frontier and structural violence. Increasingly, these impacts have been shown to be far more extensive than previously known and suggest that early figures underestimate the number of people across Australia.

Using modeled and genetics-based estimates (supported by, but not relying on, historical or ethnographic accounts), the researchers calculated a median pre-colonial Indigenous population of 2.22 million, or 0.29 people per square kilometer.

This compares with previous historical estimates of only 250,000 to 1 million people, which the researchers say are underestimates because of the far-reaching impacts of disease and frontier and structural violence that had affected populations by the time of early Australian censuses.

The new estimate also allows calculation of the number of excess deaths in the post-1788 era. To align with early census records, the model estimates that 2.06 million excess deaths (an average of about 28,200 per year) occurred between 1788 and 1861.

These...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 最新研究表明，在欧洲人到来之前，澳大利亚的原住民人口比之前想象的要多得多。研究还表明，殖民化造成的人口损失比之前认为的要大得多，估计在 1788 年第一舰队抵达后不到 80 年的时间里，前欧洲人口就损失了 93%。 弗林德斯大学全球生态学教授、澳大利亚研究委员会土著和环境历史与未来卓越中心 (CIEHF) 首席研究员科里·布拉德肖 (Corey Bradshaw) 教授是国家研究小组的成员，该研究小组与土著合作伙伴合作，调查土著人口规模随时间的变化。 他们利用复杂的计算机模型计算出，原住民人口数量比之前估计的多七倍。 “了解 1788 年欧洲入侵之前澳大利亚土著人口的规模对于讲真话与和解至关重要，”布拉德肖教授说。 研究小组通过审查人种学观察、考古和遗传重建以及对整个大陆的环境承载能力进行建模来估计殖民之前的土著人口规模，得出了新的人口估计。 之前的许多估计都以人类学家阿尔弗雷德·拉德克利夫-布朗 (Alfred Radcliffe-Brown) 在 20 世纪 30 年代对确定殖民前人口的最早尝试之一为基础，他计算出人口为 250,000 人。 然而，他承认这些价值观并未考虑致命疾病以及边境和结构性暴力的影响。越来越多的事实表明，这些影响比之前已知的要广泛得多，并表明早期数据低估了澳大利亚各地的人口数量。 研究人员利用模型和基于遗传学的估计（得到历史或人种学记载的支持，但不依赖于此），计算出前殖民时期原住民人口中位数为 222 万，即每平方公里 0.29 人。 相比之下，之前的历史估计只有 25 万到 100 万人，研究人员表示，这个数字被低估了，因为疾病以及边境和结构性暴力的影响深远，在澳大利亚早期人口普查时，这些暴力已经影响了人口。 新的估计还可以计算 1788 年之后的超额死亡人数。为了与早期人口普查记录保持一致，该模型估计 1788 年至 1861 年间发生了 206 万人超额死亡（平均每年约 28,200 人）。 这些...

reflection.en: The arrival of the First Fleet in 1788 marked the beginning of a catastrophic decline for Australia's Indigenous population, with new research estimating a loss of 93% within 80 years. This profound historical tragedy underscores the ancient prophetic call for justice to flow like a mighty river, a torrent of righteousness that would cleanse and restore.
reflection.zh: 1788年首批船的抵达标志着澳大利亚原住民人口灾难性下降的开始，新研究估计在80年内损失了93%。这一深刻的历史悲剧凸显了古老的先知呼唤，要求公义如江河滔滔，如大水泛滥的公义，能够净化和恢复。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: UK could 'unlock' 100 more oil and gas projects, say North Sea bosses
title.zh: 英国北海石油和天然气行业表示，若获政府支持，可再开发100个项目

summary.en: An industry report by Offshore Energies UK (OEUK) claims that the UK could meet half of its oil and gas needs domestically without imports if the government provides more support. The report suggests that changes to windfall taxes and approval of new fields could unlock 111 projects, attracting £50 billion in...
summary.zh: 英国离岸能源公司（OEUK）的一份行业报告声称，如果政府提供更多支持，英国可以 domestic 地满足一半的石油和天然气需求，而无需进口。报告指出，改革暴利税和批准新油气田可以启动111个项目，吸引500亿英镑的投资。然而，环保组织批评该报告不切实际。

body.en:
The UK could supply half of its oil and gas needs without imports if the government showed more support for the sector, an industry report claims.

Offshore Energies UK (OEUK) said changes to the windfall tax on energy firms and approval of the controversial Rosebank and Jackdaw fields could unlock 111 projects, attracting investment worth £50bn.

North Sea output has been falling and projections suggest that the UK's domestic supplies will meet only about a third of demand until 2050.

Environmental group Uplift branded the report a "fantasy" and said that the Prime Minister should not listen to "self-interested demands" of oil companies.

The OEUK report sets out the industry's case for supporting domestic production of oil and gas and displacing imports, which have increased.

It calls for the current Energy Profits Levy (EPL), a windfall tax on oil and gas producers which is due to be replaced in 2030, to be scrapped by next January.

The replacement Oil and Gas Revenue Levy would be triggered only when prices spike.

The sector has long said the EPL has significantly stifled investment because it remains in place even when wholesale oil and gas prices fall.

Last year, for the first time since the North Sea began producing oil and gas, not a single exploration well was drilled.

OEUK said the oil and gas industry supported 180,000 jobs in 2024 across the UK.

The report said that "fiscal reform and a pragmatic approach to licensing could unlock investment and improve long-term energy security".

It said that boosting domestic energy production was vital for "protecting households, businesses and the wider economy from global shocks".

Policy Director Enrique Cornejo added: "Britain is at a critical juncture. Our industry is ready to invest and deliver more homegrown oil and gas, but the window for action is narrowing.

"Without urgent policy decisions, the UK risks increasing its dependence on imports, losing high-value jobs."

The second demand from the industry is a signal of long term support for domestic oil and gas production.

In essence, that means approving the controversial Rosebank and Jackdaw developments which are currently being considered for permitting by the industry regulator.

Both projects had already been given the go-ahead under the previous Conservative government but were successfully challenged in the Scottish courts on environmental grounds.

It has meant all other potential projects have essentially been put on hold until the decisions are taken.

One of the environmental groups which brought the legal challenges, Uplift, has described OEUK's calls for support as a "fantasy" and says the North Sea is an "ultra-mature" basin with very little reserves left.

It said that instead of listening to the "self-interested...
body.zh: 一份行业报告称，如果政府对石油和天然气行业提供更多支持，英国可以在不进口的情况下满足其一半的石油和天然气需求。 英国离岸能源公司（OEUK）表示，对能源公司暴利税的改变以及有争议的罗斯班克和寒鸦油田的批准可能会释放111个项目，吸引价值500亿英镑的投资。 北海产量一直在下降，预计到 2050 年，英国国内供应只能满足需求的约三分之一。 环保组织Uplift将这份报告称为“幻想”，并表示总理不应听取石油公司的“自利要求”。 OEUK 报告阐述了该行业支持国内石油和天然气生产并取代进口量增加的理由。 它呼吁在明年 1 月之前废除现行的能源利润税 (EPL)，这是一项针对石油和天然气生产商的暴利税，将于 2030 年取代。 仅当价格飙升时才会触发替代石油和天然气收入税。 该行业长期以来一直表示，EPL 严重抑制了投资，因为即使石油和天然气批发价格下跌，它仍然存在。 去年，自北海开始生产石油和天然气以来，第一次没有钻探一口勘探井。 OEUK表示，到2024年，石油和天然气行业将为英国提供18万个就业岗位。 报告称，“财政改革和务实的许可方式可以释放投资并改善长期能源安全”。 报告称，提高国内能源生产对于“保护家庭、企业和更广泛的经济免受全球冲击”至关重要。 政策总监恩里克·科尔内霍补充道：“英国正处于关键时刻。我们的行业已准备好投资和提供更多本土石油和天然气，但采取行动的窗口正在缩小。 “如果不做出紧急政策决定，英国将面临增加对进口依赖、失去高价值就业机会的风险。” 行业的第二个需求是长期支持国内油气生产的信号。 从本质上讲，这意味着支持有争议的 Rosebank 和 Jackdaw 开发项目，行业监管机构目前正在考虑批准这些开发项目。 这两个项目均已在前任保守党政府的领导下获得批准，但在苏格兰法院以环境为由成功受到质疑。 这意味着所有其他潜在项目基本上都在做出决定后被搁置。 提出法律挑战的环保组织之一 Uplift 将 OEUK 的支持呼吁描述为“幻想”，并表示北海是一个“超成熟”盆地，所剩储量所剩无几。 它说，与其听“自私的……”

reflection.en: The push to unlock more oil and gas projects in the North Sea, as detailed in the OEUK report, highlights the complex interplay between economic development and environmental concerns. While industry leaders see potential for investment and energy security, critics label such proposals as 'fantasy.' This tension calls for careful consideration of long-term...
reflection.zh: 英国北海石油和天然气行业报告中提出的开发更多石油和天然气项目的呼吁，凸显了经济发展与环境关切之间的复杂互动。尽管行业领导者看到了投资和能源安全的潜力，但批评者却称这些提议是“幻想”。这种紧张关系要求我们仔细权衡长远后果以及对资源的合乎道德的管理。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: Giant jellyfish with '40ft tentacles' captured on camera
title.zh: 巨型水母“触手长达40英尺”被拍下

summary.en: Iestyn Morgan has set out to make Welsh aquatic life "more accessible" for people to see.
summary.zh: Iestyn Morgan 致力于让威尔士的水生生物“更容易被人们看到”。

body.en:
A free diver has said he "couldn't believe his luck" after spotting a giant jellyfish off the Welsh coastline.

Iestyn Morgan, from Pembrokeshire, said the lion's mane was the "length of a bus" with a size of about 10 to 15 metres (32ft 8in to 49ft 2in).

The 21-year-old conservationist, who records footage for social media to raise awareness about the "threats our seas are facing" , said it was the first lion's mane he had seen in Wales.

More commonly found in the colder waters off Scotland, a marine biologist said although the lion's mane sting was "nasty", it was not dangerous.

Morgan said he was swimming near Trefin Beach in Pembrokeshire when he spotted the tentacles in the water.

He initially thought it was a compass jellyfish , which are native to UK waters, before realising it was too big.

"It must have been the length of a bus or small train. I couldn't believe how big it was."

The Wildlife Trusts , external said the lion's mane jellyfish gets its name from its long tentacles, and has "all the beauty and bite of a lion".

They can grow up to 3m (9ft 8in) in length, but the tentacles - which are used to catch their prey - can exceed 30 to 36.5 metres (98ft 4in to 119ft 8in) making it one of the longest animals on Earth.

Marine biologist Dr Cathy Lucas, from the University of Southampton, said Morgan's video showed the animal's incredible length.

"The tentacles are so long and so fine you might not even see them," she said, recalling how during field work in Scotland divers would get bits of tentacles on them when there were no jellyfish around.

"They still sting after they break off," she said, adding that while the sting was "nasty" and "the worst in the UK", it was not dangerous.

"The advice is not to touch them and if you get a bit of tentacle on your skin flick it off with a stick and wash in warm water to neutralise," she said.

Lucas said lion's manes "occasionally" reach the Welsh coast later in the summer or autumn, according to jellyfish sightings recorded by the public, but their main habitat in the UK was Scotland.

Morgan feels we should be "grateful" they were in Wales, adding they were not "big scary monsters" as some people may think.

"Your biggest problem is if you swim into them. You don't want to get stung by a lion's mane."

Morgan said he was seeing "more and more" jellyfish coming into Welsh waters as he was filming.

He said it was part of a theme in which he was noticing warm water species "becoming more abundant".

"I don't have enough summers to compare it to, but I put down a camera a few weeks ago and saw a Triggerfish, which is native to the Mediterranean," he added.

Morgan said creating his content has been "very rewarding" as he wanted to make aquatic environments "more accessible" to people.

But he...
body.zh: 一名自由潜水员在威尔士海岸线发现巨型水母后表示，他“简直不敢相信自己的运气”。 来自彭布罗克郡的 Iestyn Morgan 表示，狮子的鬃毛有“一辆公共汽车的长度”，大小约为 10 至 15 米（32 英尺 8 英寸至 49 英尺 2 英寸）。 这位 21 岁的自然资源保护主义者为社交媒体录制视频，以提高人们对“我们的海洋面临的威胁”的认识，他说这是他在威尔士看到的第一只狮子鬃毛。 一位海洋生物学家表示，这种狮子在苏格兰附近较冷的水域中更为常见，尽管狮子的主要螫刺很“恶心”，但并不危险。 摩根说，他在彭布罗克郡特雷芬海滩附近游泳时，发现了水中的触手。 他最初以为这是一种罗盘水母，原产于英国水域，后来意识到它太大了。 “它一定有公共汽车或小火车的长度。我简直不敢相信它有多大。” 野生动物信托基金会对外表示，狮鬃水母因其长长的触手而得名，并且具有“狮子的所有美丽和咬合力”。 它们的长度可达 3 m（9 英尺 8 英寸），但用于捕捉猎物的触手可超过 30 至 36.5 米（98 英尺 4 英寸至 119 英尺 8 英寸），使其成为地球上最长的动物之一。 南安普顿大学的海洋生物学家凯茜·卢卡斯博士说，摩根的视频显示了这种动物令人难以置信的长度。 “触手又长又细，你可能根本看不到它们，”她说，并回忆起在苏格兰进行野外工作时，当周围没有水母时，潜水员会在触手上沾上一些触手。 她说：“它们折断后仍然会蜇人。”她补充说，虽然蜇人的感觉“很恶心”，而且是“英国最严重的”，但并不危险。 她说：“建议不要触摸它们，如果皮肤上有一点触手，请用棍子将其弹开，然后用温水清洗以中和。” 卢卡斯表示，根据公众记录的水母目击事件，狮鬃“偶尔”会在夏季或秋季晚些时候到达威尔士海岸，但它们在英国的主要栖息地是苏格兰。 摩根认为我们应该“感激”他们在威尔士，并补充说他们并不像某些人想象的那样是“可怕的大怪物”。 “你最大的问题是，如果你游进它们里。你不想被狮子的鬃毛蜇到。” 摩根表示，在拍摄过程中，他看到“越来越多”的水母进入威尔士水域。 他说，这是他注意到暖水物种“变得更加丰富”的主题的一部分。 “我没有足够的夏天来比较，但几周前我放下相机，看到了一种原产于地中海的炮弹鱼，”他补充道。 摩根表示，创作内容“非常有意义”，因为他想让人们“更容易接触到”水生环境。 但他...

reflection.en: A free diver's encounter with a massive lion's mane jellyfish off the Welsh coast is a reminder of the wonders hidden in our oceans. Iestyn Morgan's work to share these sights aims to foster appreciation and awareness of marine life, turning a potentially frightening encounter into an opportunity for education and conservation. This effort to bring the...
reflection.zh: 一位自由潜水员在威尔士海岸附近邂逅巨型狮鬃水母，这提醒我们海洋中隐藏着多少奇迹。Iestyn Morgan 致力于分享这些景象，旨在培养人们对海洋生物的欣赏和认识，将一次可能令人恐惧的相遇转化为教育和保护的机会。这种努力将海洋之美带给人们，尽管海洋面临挑战，却体现了一种积极参与的精神。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: They’re the sopranos of the forest, so what’s silencing the gibbons’ morning chorus?
title.zh: 它们是森林里的女高音，是什么让长臂猿的晨歌沉默了？

summary.en: As human development and roads increasingly fragment their habitats, a study suggests traffic noise could be altering the animals’ wake-up call. In a corner of Malaysian forest bordered by housing and roads, resident white-handed gibbons are quiet, with only the hum of traffic audible, suggesting noise pollution may...
summary.zh: 随着人类开发和道路日益分割它们的栖息地，一项研究表明交通噪音可能正在改变动物的唤醒歌声。在马来西亚一片被住房和道路包围的森林角落里，白手长臂猿保持沉默，只能听到附近高速公路的交通噪音，这表明噪音污染可能正在影响它们的鸣叫。

body.en: As human development and roads increasingly fragment their habitats, a study suggests traffic noise could be altering the animals’ wake-up call Dawn has broken, and the air is cool and still. It’s at about this time that gibbons usually erupt into song, wa-oo-ing and wa-ing from the highest branches and filling the tree tops with rich melodies. But in this corner of Malaysian forest, bordered by housing and roads, the resident white-handed gibbons are quiet. All that can be heard is the hum of traffic from a nearby highway. This isn’t a rare occurrence for this group of gibbons, according to research, which found these particular gibbons, named Mambang and Walinong, appeared to be producing far fewer morning songs than others that are not exposed to the same level of traffic noise. Continue reading...
body.zh: 随着人类发展和道路日益破碎它们的栖息地，一项研究表明，交通噪音可能会改变动物的叫醒声黎明已经破晓，空气凉爽而宁静。大约在这个时候，长臂猿通常会从最高的树枝上发出呜呜呜的歌声，让树顶充满丰富的旋律。但在马来西亚森林的这个角落，毗邻房屋和道路，居住的白掌长臂猿却很安静。只能听到附近高速公路传来的交通声。根据研究，这种情况对于这群长臂猿来说并不罕见，研究发现这些特殊的长臂猿，名为曼邦（Mambang）和瓦利农（Walinong），与其他没有暴露在同等交通噪音水平下的长臂猿相比，早上发出的歌曲似乎要少得多。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The vibrant morning chorus of gibbons, a testament to the intricate beauty of creation, is being muted by the encroaching sounds of human activity. This disruption serves as a poignant reminder that the natural world, in its very existence and order, speaks of its Creator's power and wisdom. When we diminish the natural symphony, we obscure a part of that...
reflection.zh: 长臂猿充满活力的晨歌是造物之美的一份证明，却被日益逼近的人类活动声响所压制。这种干扰令人痛心地提醒我们，自然界本身的存在和秩序都在诉说着其创造者的能力和智慧。当我们削弱了自然的交响乐，我们就遮蔽了那神圣启示的一部分。

verse.textEn: Since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made.
verse.textZh: 自从造天地以来，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，虽是眼不能见，但借着所造之物就可以晓得。

title.en: Is collagen all hype? – podcast
title.zh: 胶原蛋白是炒作吗？——播客

summary.en: Collagen supplements have surged in popularity with claims of smoothing wrinkles, promoting hair growth, and easing joint pain. However, distinguishing the scientific evidence from marketing hype can be challenging. A podcast explores the science behind collagen, how to obtain it naturally, and the difficulties in...
summary.zh: 胶原蛋白补充剂近年来销量激增，声称能抚平皱纹、促进毛发生长并缓解关节疼痛。然而，在营销宣传的喧嚣中，很难辨别其中的科学依据。一个播客节目深入探讨了胶原蛋白背后的科学原理，如何通过天然途径获取，以及验证健康养生主张的困难。

body.en: Collagen powders, gummies and pills have boomed in popularity in recent years boosted by claims that they smooth wrinkles, promote glossy hair and help with joint pain. Amid the noise it can be hard to figure out whether there’s any actual science behind the promise of looking younger for longer. Luckily Dr Xand van Tulleken has spent the past three years writing Make Me Well: a quest to understand the confusing world of wellness, and his chapter on collagen dives deep into the evidence. He tells Madeleine Finlay what collagen does in the body, how we can get it without splashing out on expensive supplements, and why getting to the truth behind wellness claims can be so hard Order Make Me Well from the Guardian Bookshop Support the Guardian: theguardian.com/sciencepod Continue reading...
body.zh: 近年来，胶原蛋白粉、软糖和药丸迅速流行起来，因为它们声称可以抚平皱纹、促进头发光泽并有助于缓解关节疼痛。在喧嚣声中，很难弄清楚让自己看起来更年轻的承诺背后是否有任何真正的科学依据。幸运的是，Xand van Tulleken 博士在过去三年里一直在撰写《Make Me Well：探索令人困惑的健康世界》一书，他关于胶原蛋白的章节深入探讨了证据。他告诉玛德琳芬利胶原蛋白在体内的作用，我们如何在不花昂贵的补充剂的情况下获得胶原蛋白，以及为什么了解健康声明背后的真相如此困难来自卫报书店的订单让我健康支持卫报：theguardian.com/sciencepod 继续阅读...

reflection.en: In a world saturated with information and persuasive marketing, discerning truth can feel like navigating a minefield. The quest for wellness, as explored in this story, often gets tangled in claims that lack solid evidence. Philippians 4:8 reminds us to focus our minds on what is true, honorable, and commendable, helping us cut through the noise to find...
reflection.zh: 在一个信息爆炸、营销宣传无处不在的世界里，辨别真相有时感觉像是在雷区中行走。正如这个故事所探讨的，对健康的追求常常被缺乏坚实证据的主张所困扰。腓立比书4:8提醒我们要将心思意念集中在真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、有美名的事上，帮助我们拨开喧嚣，找到真正的理解。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Ebola outbreak in DRC has peaked, say authorities, as infection rates slow
title.zh: 刚果（金）当局称埃博拉疫情已过高峰，感染率放缓

summary.en: Authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have announced that the Ebola outbreak ravaging parts of the country has reached its peak. For the first time since the epidemic was declared in May, the numbers of people becoming infected is slowing down, according to officials. Strict adherence to preventive...
summary.zh: 刚果（民主）共和国当局已宣布，肆虐该国部分地区的埃博拉疫情已达到高峰。官员们表示，自5月宣布疫情以来，首次出现感染人数放缓的迹象。刚果卫生部长塞缪尔·罗杰·坎巴指出，邦迪布吉奥变种埃博拉的传播有所下降，但强调必须严格遵守预防措施。

body.en:
About this content Prosper Heri Ngorora in Goma Tue 15 Sep 2026 00.00 EDT Last modified on Tue 15 Sep 2026 00.02 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google Authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have announced that the Ebola outbreak ravaging parts of the country has reached its peak.

For the first time since the epidemic was declared in May, the numbers of people becoming infected is slowing down, according to officials.

Stressing that strict adherence to preventive measures needed to be kept in place, Samuel Roger Kamba, the Congolese health minister, said there was a decline in transmission of the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola .

“We are fighting a very dangerous virus that is killing many of our people. Today, we can say that the outbreak is under control,” he said. “At one point, we were recording about 120 cases per day; today, we’re seeing about 80 per day. So the number of new cases is decreasing every day.

“It has been more than 22 days since 10 of the 62 health zones have reported new cases. And so we can now definitively remove six health zones from the list because they have gone more than 42 days without new cases, and we can remove four health zones that have gone more than 21 days without a new case,” Kamba said.

Last week, the Sud-Ubangi region, on the DRC’s borders with Congo-Brazzaville and Central African Republic, became the sixth province to report the disease.

The Bundibugyo virus outbreak was declared by Congolese authorities on 15 May and is concentrated primarily in Ituri province, where ongoing conflict has created challenging conditions for those responding to the disease. It is the 17th outbreak of Ebola in the DRC since the highly contagious disease was first identified and named in 1976.

No effective treatment for the Bundibugyo variant has been found so far but there are clinical trials in the region. The DRC received more than 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine last month, which is the only approved treatment for the more common Zaire Ebola virus.

According to the latest data from the Congolese health ministry, the number of confirmed cases stood at more than 7,200, including more than 3,475 deaths , as of 14 September.

While welcoming the progress made, Iracan Gratien de Saint-Nicolas, an MP for Bunia, warned against what he called “triumphalism” and stressed that efforts must intensify to show people that the disease was under control.

Gratien Iracan called for lessons to be learned from failures in epidemiological surveillance that contributed to the rapid spread of the disease.

The MP also expressed some scepticism over the government announcement. “Claims that an epidemic is under control must be supported by objective indicators. If the indicators show that the epidemic is indeed under control,...
body.zh: 关于此内容 戈马的 Prosper Heri Ngorora 2026 年 9 月 15 日星期二 00.00 EDT 最后修改时间 2026 年 9 月 15 日星期二 00.02 EDT 分享 更喜欢 Google 上的卫报 刚果民主共和国当局宣布，肆虐该国部分地区的埃博拉疫情已达到顶峰。 官员称，自五月宣布疫情以来，感染人数首次放缓。 刚果卫生部长塞缪尔·罗杰·坎巴强调，必须严格遵守预防措施，并表示本迪布焦变种埃博拉病毒的传播有所减少。 “我们正在对抗一种非常危险的病毒，它正在夺走我们许多人的生命。今天，我们可以说疫情已得到控制，”他说。 “曾经，我们每天记录约 120 例病例；今天，我们每天记录约 80 例。因此，新病例数量每天都在减少。 “62个卫生区中有10个报告新病例已经过去22天多了。因此，我们现在可以明确地将 6 个卫生区从名单中删除，因为它们已经超过 42 天没有出现新病例，我们可以删除 4 个已经超过 21 天没有新病例的卫生区，”坎巴说。 上周，位于刚果民主共和国与刚果-布拉柴维尔和中非共和国接壤的南乌班吉地区成为报告这种疾病的第六个省份。 刚果当局于 5 月 15 日宣布本迪布焦病毒爆发，主要集中在伊图里省，该省持续的冲突给应对该疾病的人员带来了挑战性的条件。这是自 1976 年首次发现并命名埃博拉这种高度传染性疾病以来，刚果民主共和国爆发的第 17 次埃博拉疫情。 迄今为止，尚未发现针对 Bundibugyo 变种的有效治疗方法，但该地区已有临床试验。刚果民主共和国上个月接收了超过 70,000 剂 Ervebo 疫苗，这是针对更常见的扎伊尔埃博拉病毒的唯一获批治疗方法。 根据刚果卫生部的最新数据，截至9月14日，确诊病例已超过7,200例，其中死亡病例超过3,475例。 布尼亚议员伊拉坎·格拉蒂安·德·圣尼古拉斯在欢迎所取得的进展的同时，警告不要出现他所谓的“必胜主义”，并强调必须加大努力，向人们表明这种疾病已得到控制。 格拉蒂恩·伊拉坎（Gratien Iracan）呼吁从导致疾病迅速传播的流行病学监测失败中汲取教训。 这位议员还对政府的声明表示了一些怀疑。 “声称疫情已得到控制必须有客观指标的支持。如果各项指标表明疫情确实得到控制的话……

reflection.en: After months of devastating loss, with nearly 3,500 lives claimed by the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola, authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo report that the outbreak has peaked. This news offers a fragile hope, a sign that even prolonged suffering can eventually begin to recede. It is a reminder that Yahweh's mercies are new each morning, even...
reflection.zh: 在近3500人因邦迪布吉奥变种埃博拉丧生、经历了数月毁灭性损失之后，刚果（民主）共和国当局报告称疫情已达到高峰。这一消息带来了脆弱的希望，表明即使是长期的苦难也可能最终开始消退。这提醒我们，雅伟的怜悯每早都是新的，即使黑夜漫长而黑暗。

verse.textEn: Because of Yahweh's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.
verse.textZh: 我们不至消灭，是出于雅伟诸般的慈爱；是因他的怜悯不至断绝。每早晨这都是新的。

title.en: Scientists to probe the source behind a massive 1946 tsunami
title.zh: 科学家将探究 1946 年巨大海啸的源头

summary.en: Eighty years ago, a massive tsunami devastated parts of Hawaii, Alaska, Washington and Oregon following an earthquake off the coast of Alaska. A Michigan State University team is launching a project to study the underwater fault system where it originated—and whether it still poses a risk today.
summary.zh: 八十年前，一次大地震引发的巨大海啸摧毁了夏威夷、阿拉斯加、华盛顿和俄勒冈的部分地区。密歇根州立大学的一个团队正在启动一个项目，研究海啸的起源——位于阿拉斯加海岸附近的水下断层系统，并评估其今日是否仍构成威胁。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Eighty years ago, a massive tsunami devastated parts of Hawaii, Alaska, Washington and Oregon following an earthquake off the coast of Alaska. A Michigan State University team is launching a project to study the underwater fault system where it originated—and whether it still poses a risk today.

Songqiao "Shawn" Wei, associate professor of earth and environmental sciences as well as computational mathematics, science and engineering, is gearing up for an expedition to measure vibrations of tectonic plates in the Alaskan–Aleutian subduction zone.

For this project, Wei's team will place waterproof sensors called seismometers at the bottom of the Pacific Ocean near Alaska. They'll use atomic clocks to accurately time each vibration they record. A battery will power the sensor for 15 months, at which point Wei's team will collect the sensors to analyze the data.

A project of this magnitude takes more money and planning than tracking vibrations on land. That's where a National Science Foundation grant comes in.

MSU is partnering with the University of Hawaii in the first NSF award of its kind since January 2025. The team is also receiving ship time and instrument usage for the project.

Wei is studying this area because the 1946 tsunami was caused by a relatively small earthquake there. How this happened is still a mystery to seismologists.

While the sensors can't tell researchers what happened 80 years ago, they can reveal how the fault is behaving today and help scientists assess whether the region could produce another earthquake or tsunami.

"We are still far from predicting earthquakes," Wei said. "But we can improve our understanding of this local region, and that will be incorporated into the U.S. Geological Survey's risk map and then into building codes."

Earthquakes happen when tectonic plates, which move along faults in the Earth's lithosphere, get stuck against each other, building up pressure until they suddenly slip. This releases energy that shakes the ground.

Seismologists—researchers who study earthquakes—can use this energy to image the Earth's interior. Tracking this data is critical for understanding why earthquakes happen, but collecting it is a matter of being in the right place at the right time.

That's why Wei places seismometers in known earthquake hot spots like Samoa, Alaska and the Marianas and keeps them there for months or years.

Over time, the seismometers record every vibration so Wei can analyze the data once the sensors are collected.

Faults on land are much easier to study. Typically, seismometers track vibrations for years, thanks...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 八十年前，阿拉斯加海岸发生地震后，一场巨大的海啸摧毁了夏威夷、阿拉斯加、华盛顿和俄勒冈州的部分地区。密歇根州立大学的一个团队正在启动一个项目，研究水下断层系统的起源，以及它今天是否仍然构成风险。 地球与环境科学以及计算数学、科学与工程系副教授 Songqiao“Shawn”Wei 正在准备一次测量阿拉斯加-阿留申俯冲带构造板块振动的考察。 在这个项目中，魏的团队将在阿拉斯加附近的太平洋底部放置称为地震仪的防水传感器。他们将使用原子钟来准确记录他们记录的每次振动。电池将为传感器供电 15 个月，届时 Wei 的团队将收集传感器来分析数据。 如此规模的项目比跟踪陆地振动需要更多的资金和规划。这就是国家科学基金会拨款的用武之地。 自 2025 年 1 月以来，密歇根州立大学与夏威夷大学合作，获得了首个此类 NSF 奖项。该团队还获得了该项目的船舶时间和仪器使用情况。 魏正在研究这个地区，因为1946年的海啸是由那里相对较小的地震引起的。对于地震学家来说，这是如何发生的仍然是个谜。 虽然传感器无法告诉研究人员 80 年前发生了什么，但它们可以揭示断层今天的表现，并帮助科学家评估该地区是否可能再次发生地震或海啸。 “我们距离预测地震还很远，”魏说。 “但我们可以提高对这个当地地区的了解，这将被纳入美国地质调查局的风险地图，然后纳入建筑规范。” 当沿着地球岩石圈断层移动的构造板块相互卡住，压力增大直至突然滑动时，就会发生地震。这会释放出震动地面的能量。 地震学家（研究地震的研究人员）可以利用这种能量对地球内部进行成像。跟踪这些数据对于理解地震发生的原因至关重要，但收集数据需要在正确的时间出现在正确的地点。 这就是为什么魏将地震仪放置在已知的地震热点地区，如萨摩亚、阿拉斯加和马里亚纳群岛，并在那里放置数月或数年。 随着时间的推移，地震仪会记录每次振动，这样魏就可以在传感器收集到数据后分析数据。 陆地上的断层更容易研究。通常，地震仪会跟踪振动多年，谢谢......

reflection.en: The 1946 tsunami serves as a stark reminder of the immense power of natural forces beyond human control. As scientists probe the origins of such events, they confront the deep mysteries of our planet, echoing the ancient question, 'Where were you when I laid the earth’s foundation?' (Job 38:4). This pursuit of knowledge, while vital, should also foster...
reflection.zh: 1946 年的海啸事件，令人警醒地提醒我们，自然界存在着人类无法掌控的巨大力量。当科学家们探究此类事件的起源时，他们也面对着我们星球深邃的奥秘，这不禁让人想起古老的提问：“我铺设大地的根基时，你你在哪里？”（约伯记 38:4）。这种对知识的追求固然至关重要，但也应培养我们面对浩瀚而复杂的受造界时的谦卑之心。

verse.textEn: Where were you when I laid the earth's foundation? Tell me, if you understand.
verse.textZh: 我立大地根基的时候，你在哪里呢？你若有聪明，只管说吧。

title.en: Plague was killing entire families thousands of years before the Black Death
title.zh: 数千年前的黑死病之前，瘟疫就已经在杀死整个家族

summary.en: Ancient DNA analysis indicates that plague was responsible for deaths among Siberian hunter-gatherers as early as 5,500 years ago, predating urban environments and flea-borne epidemics. These early strains may have been particularly virulent due to a genetic factor that triggered severe immune responses.
summary.zh: 古代DNA分析表明，早在5500年前，瘟疫就已经在西伯利亚的狩猎采集者中造成死亡，这早于城市环境和受蚤传播的流行病。这些早期菌株可能由于一种能引发严重免疫反应的遗传因素而具有特别的毒性。

body.en:
Plague is often linked to rats, packed medieval cities, and the devastating epidemics that tore through Europe during and after the Middle Ages.

But new research published in Nature suggests the disease was already a deadly threat 5,500 years ago. At that time, it was killing people in small, mobile hunter-gatherer groups - long before farming and urban life created the crowded conditions usually associated with major plague outbreaks.

An international research team studied ancient DNA recovered from human remains at four hunter-gatherer burial sites in the Lake Baikal region of East Siberia. By sequencing genetic material preserved in teeth, the scientists were able to reconstruct ancient bacterial genomes and identify previously unknown early forms of plague.

"Whether the earliest forms of plague were mild or virulent has been a matter of debate, but our findings demonstrate that these ancient strains were already highly lethal," says senior author Eske Willerslev, Professor at the University of Copenhagen and the University of Cambridge.

To understand what happened within these prehistoric communities, the researchers combined genetic evidence with archaeology and radiocarbon dating.

"Based on the plague DNA, the genetic relationships between the victims, the archaeological analysis and the radiocarbon dating, we've built a really clear, complete picture of what happened during these outbreaks," says lead author Ruairidh Macleod, who carried out the work while a PhD student at the University of Cambridge - and is now Research Fellow at the University of Oxford.

The team found DNA from Yersinia pestis - the bacterium that causes plague - in 18 of the 46 people tested. That means nearly 40 percent of the individuals carried evidence of plague, a detection rate even higher than that reported at some medieval plague burial sites.

Earlier research had shown that ancient strains of Yersinia pestis were missing some of the genetic features that eventually allowed bubonic plague to spread efficiently through fleas and rodent hosts. Because of that, scientists had often assumed that the earliest versions of the bacterium probably could not trigger severe outbreaks.

At the two largest cemeteries, researchers found an unusually large number of children and young teenagers among those who had died. Archaeologists had struggled for decades to explain why so many young people were buried there over such a short period.

"The unusually high number of children and the short timespan was a real puzzle that we've been trying to solve since the 1990s. Finding out that plague was the cause is extraordinary, but it makes so much sense," says archaeologist Andrzej Weber of the University of Alberta, Principal Investigator of the Baikal Archaeology...
body.zh: 鼠疫通常与老鼠、拥挤的中世纪城市以及中世纪期间和之后席卷欧洲的毁灭性流行病有关。 但《自然》杂志发表的新研究表明，这种疾病在 5500 年前就已经是一种致命的威胁。当时，它正在杀死小型、流动的狩猎采集群体中的人们——早在农业和城市生活造成通常与大规模鼠疫爆发相关的拥挤环境之前。 一个国际研究小组研究了从东西伯利亚贝加尔湖地区四个狩猎采集者墓地的人类遗骸中发现的古代 DNA。通过对牙齿中保存的遗传物质进行测序，科学家们能够重建古代细菌基因组并识别出以前未知的鼠疫早期形式。 哥本哈根大学和剑桥大学教授、资深作者埃斯克·威勒斯莱夫（Eske Willerslev）说：“最早的鼠疫形式是温和的还是致命的一直是一个争论的问题，但我们的研究结果表明这些古老的菌株已经具有高度致命性。” 为了了解这些史前群落内发生的事情，研究人员将遗传证据与考古学和放射性碳测年相结合。 主要作者 Ruairidh Macleod 说：“根据鼠疫 DNA、受害者之间的遗传关系、考古分析和放射性碳测年，我们对这些疫情爆发期间发生的情况绘制了一幅非常清晰、完整的图景。”Ruairidh Macleod 在剑桥大学攻读博士学位时开展了这项工作，现在是牛津大学的研究员。 研究小组在 46 名接受测试的人中，有 18 人发现了鼠疫耶尔森氏菌（引起鼠疫的细菌）的 DNA。这意味着近 40% 的人携带鼠疫证据，这一检出率甚至高于一些中世纪鼠疫埋葬地点报告的检出率。 早期的研究表明，鼠疫耶尔森氏菌的古老菌株缺失了一些基因特征，而这些基因特征最终使得黑死病能够通过跳蚤和啮齿动物宿主有效传播。正因为如此，科学家们经常假设这种细菌的最早版本可能不会引发严重的疫情爆发。 在两个最大的墓地，研究人员发现死者中儿童和青少年的数量异常多。几十年来，考古学家一直在努力解释为什么在如此短的时间内有这么多年轻人被埋在那里。 贝加尔湖考古学首席研究员、阿尔伯塔大学考古学家安杰伊·韦伯 (Andrzej Weber) 表示：“儿童数量异常多，时间跨度短，这是我们自 20 世纪 90 年代以来一直在努力解决的一个真正难题。发现瘟疫是原因是非同寻常的，但它非常有意义。”

reflection.en: The discovery that plague ravaged small, mobile groups thousands of years ago, long before the conditions we associate with its spread, humbles our understanding of history and disease. It reminds us that even as we uncover ancient truths through science, there remains a vastness to what we do not know, a mystery that points beyond our current knowledge.
reflection.zh: 瘟疫在数千年前就已在小型游牧群体中肆虐，远早于我们所认为的传播条件，这一发现令我们对历史和疾病的理解感到谦卑。它提醒我们，即使我们通过科学揭示了古老的真相，我们仍然有许多未知之处，存在着超越我们当前知识的奥秘。

verse.textEn: Where were you when I laid the earth's foundation? Tell me, if you understand.
verse.textZh: 我立大地根基的时候，你在哪里呢？你若有聪明，只管说吧。

title.en: Australia must double down to meet our climate targets, new study shows how
title.zh: 新研究显示，澳大利亚必须加倍努力才能实现我们的气候目标

summary.en: Global warming is projected to exceed the 1.5°C threshold of the Paris Agreement within five years, leading to severe consequences like melting ice sheets and bleached coral reefs. The study emphasizes the need to limit 'overshoot' temperatures and duration, as even small increases and prolonged periods above the...
summary.zh: 根据一项新研究，全球变暖将在五年内突破《巴黎协定》设定的1.5°C阈值，这将导致冰盖加速融化和珊瑚礁白化等严重后果。该研究强调，必须限制全球温度“超调”的幅度和持续时间，因为即使是微小的升温和长时间的超标都会造成不可逆转的生态破坏。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Within the next five years, global warming is set to breach the 1.5°C threshold at the heart of the 2015 Paris Agreement . This will have dire consequences , from rapidly melting ice sheets to ghostly white coral reefs .

To date, the world has failed to tackle climate change head-on. We must now focus on limiting the magnitude and duration of " overshoot "—how much global temperatures exceed the 1.5°C limit .
