Every fraction of a degree our planet warms, and every year spent there, will inflict irreversible ecological damage.

A new report , developed by my research team at Climate Analytics and the Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research, asks a simple question: What can Australia do to limit this overshoot?

Our latest research suggests the world can still limit peak warming to about 1.7°C, reach net-zero greenhouse gas emissions in the 2060s and bring warming back below 1.5°C by 2100. But only if governments take urgent and ambitious action.

Fossil fuels—including oil, coal and gas—account for more than 75% of global greenhouse gas emissions. To curb climate change, we must rapidly transition away from their use. Australia committed to this goal at COP28 in 2023, at COP30 by signing the Belém Declaration and at the Santa Marta conference in April 2026.

In Australia, we've had too many reminders of what's at stake: the horrific Black Summer fires of 2019–20; repeated record floods, including across Queensland and northern New South Wales following Cyclone Debbie in 2017 ; and the mass bleaching of the Great Barrier Reef , Ningaloo and Scott reefs.

Now, a potentially record-shattering El Niño is forming. Research suggests it could temporarily push global warming toward 1.7°C or even 1.8°C in 2027, likely bringing extreme heat and drought conditions to Australia.

Our new report shows Australia can realistically meet our climate targets. But that demands we urgently adopt an ambitious emissions pathway built on the Paris Agreement.

Discover the latest in science, tech, and space with over 100,000 subscribers who rely on Phys.org for daily insights. Sign up for our free newsletter and get updates on breakthroughs, innovations, and research that matter— daily or weekly .

A Paris-aligned emissions pathway would require Australia to transform its energy system.

Fossil fuels supply about 90% of our country's raw energy and make up a large share of our greenhouse gas emissions. Australia is also one of the world's biggest fossil fuel exporters, producing roughly 4.5% of global carbon dioxide emissions.

To achieve our suggested pathway, Australia's net emissions...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 未来五年内，全球变暖将突破 2015 年《巴黎协定》核心规定的 1.5°C 阈值。这将产生可怕的后果，从迅速融化的冰盖到幽灵般的白色珊瑚礁。 迄今为止，世界未能正面应对气候变化。我们现在必须集中精力限制“超调”的幅度和持续时间——全球气温超出 1.5°C 限制的程度。我们的星球每变暖一度，每年在地球上度过的每一年，都会造成不可逆转的生态破坏。 我在气候分析和波茨坦气候影响研究所的研究团队编写的一份新报告提出了一个简单的问题：澳大利亚可以采取哪些措施来限制这种超调？ 我们的最新研究表明，世界仍然可以将峰值升温限制在 1.7°C 左右，在 2060 年代实现温室气体净零排放，到 2100 年将升温控制在 1.5°C 以下。但前提是各国政府采取紧急而雄心勃勃的行动。 化石燃料（包括石油、煤炭和天然气）占全球温室气体排放量的 75% 以上。为了遏制气候变化，我们必须迅速停止使用它们。澳大利亚在 2023 年的 COP28、COP30 上签署了《贝伦宣言》以及 2026 年 4 月的圣玛尔塔会议上承诺实现这一目标。 在澳大利亚，我们已经收到了太多关于危险的提醒：2019-20 年可怕的黑夏火灾； 2017 年黛比飓风过后，昆士兰州和新南威尔士州北部多次发生创纪录的洪水；以及大堡礁、宁加洛礁和斯科特礁的大规模白化。 现在，可能破纪录的厄尔尼诺现象正在形成。研究表明，它可能会暂时将全球变暖推向 2027 年 1.7°C 甚至 1.8°C，并可能给澳大利亚带来极端炎热和干旱的情况。 我们的新报告显示澳大利亚可以切实实现我们的气候目标。但这要求我们紧急采取基于《巴黎协定》的雄心勃勃的排放途径。 通过 Phys.org 获取每日见解的超过 100,000 名订阅者发现科学、技术和太空领域的最新动态。订阅我们的免费新闻通讯，每天或每周获取重要突破、创新和研究的最新动态。 与《巴黎协定》一致的排放路径将要求澳大利亚转变其能源系统。 化石燃料供应了我国约90%的原始能源，并在我国温室气体排放中占据很大一部分。澳大利亚也是世界上最大的化石燃料出口国之一，二氧化碳排放量约占全球的 4.5%。 为了实现我们建议的途径，澳大利亚的净排放量......

reflection.en: The news highlights the urgent reality of climate change, warning of irreversible damage to creation. Genesis 1:31 declares God's finished work 'very good.' This calls us to responsible stewardship, to protect and preserve the delicate balance of the world entrusted to us, rather than allowing it to be irrevocably harmed.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻突显了气候变化的严峻现实，并警告将对受造界造成不可逆转的损害。《创世记》1章31节宣告上帝已完成的创造是“甚好的”。这呼召我们承担起负责任的管理责任，去保护和保存托付给我们、却又脆弱无比的世界的平衡，而不是任其受到无法挽回的伤害。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: Dense galaxies are carving out a bubble in the early universe
title.zh: 致密的星系在早期宇宙中开辟了一个气泡

summary.en: The first science results from the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) represent a significant achievement in scientific vision and perseverance. Despite facing budget overruns and near-cancellation over its 25-year development, the telescope's successful launch and subsequent data have brought relief and excitement to...
summary.zh: 詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜（JWST）的首批科学成果的发布，标志着科学远见和毅力的巨大胜利。尽管在其25年的开发过程中，该望远镜曾面临预算超支和濒临取消的困境，但其最终成功发射并传回数据，给天文学界带来了巨大的宽慰和兴奋。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

When JWST's first science results started rolling in, it was a triumph for scientific vision and persistence. For years, the fate of the powerful space telescope was uncertain. It went way over budget, and for 25 years, troubling conversations accompanied its ongoing development. Several times, it seemed like it would be canceled, and in 2011, Congress came close to ending the program.

So when it was finally launched on Dec. 25, 2021, there was a collective sigh of relief in the astronomy community. As observations began, astronomers, cosmologists, exoplanet scientists and astrophysicists around the world anticipated the telescope's findings.

The telescope didn't disappoint. JWST found surprisingly bright, well-developed galaxies only several hundred million years after the Big Bang, clashing with our scientific understanding at the time. Since its initial observations, JWST has continued to stun us with its early universe findings.

One of JWST's first and most important surveys was JADES, the JWST Advanced Deep Extragalactic Survey. JADES is responsible for many of the telescope's surprising observations of the young universe.

The shock at JWST's findings has subsided somewhat, and now astronomers are examining these findings more deeply to see what they can learn. In new research in The Astrophysical Journal based on JADES, researchers found a " galaxy overdensity candidate " that could help explain the universe's reionization. Reionization is when the first stars and galaxies formed and illuminated their surroundings, reionizing hydrogen atoms in the primordial universe.

Prior to this, the universe was opaque and dark. After this, photons were free to travel and the cosmos lit up.

The research is titled "JADES: A Prominent Galaxy Overdensity Candidate within the First 500 Myr," and the lead author is Zihao Wu. Wu is from the Center for Astrophysics, Harvard & Smithsonian.

"We report a galaxy overdensity candidate at z ≈ 10.5 in the JWST Advanced Deep Extragalactic Survey," the authors write. It contains 18 galaxies in a comoving group, which is a very dense arrangement.

"The galaxy number density is four times higher than the field expectation, accounting for one-third of comparably bright galaxies and nearly 50% of the total star formation rate (SFR)" in a specific field and redshift in the GOODS-S field.

More of the galaxies in this overdensity have close companions and substructures than in the field at large, and the authors say that's evidence of interactions.

The stellar masses of these galaxies and their star formation rates are a little higher...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 当 JWST 的第一个科学成果开始出现时，这是科学远见和毅力的胜利。多年来，这台强大的太空望远镜的命运一直不确定。它远远超出了预算，25 年来，伴随着它的持续开发，令人不安的对话。有几次，该计划似乎会被取消，2011 年，国会差点终止该计划。 因此，当它最终于 2021 年 12 月 25 日推出时，天文学界集体松了一口气。随着观测开始，世界各地的天文学家、宇宙学家、系外行星科学家和天体物理学家都期待着望远镜的发现。 望远镜没有让人失望。詹姆斯韦伯太空望远镜在大爆炸后仅几亿年就发现了令人惊讶的明亮、发育良好的星系，这与我们当时的科学理解相冲突。自最初观测以来，JWST 的早期宇宙发现继续让我们震惊。 JWST 的第一个也是最重要的巡天之一是 JADES，即 JWST 高级深河外巡天。 JADES 负责望远镜对年轻宇宙的许多令人惊讶的观测。 对 JWST 发现的震惊已经有所减弱，现在天文学家正在更深入地研究这些发现，看看他们能学到什么。在《天体物理学杂志》基于 JADES 的新研究中，研究人员发现了一个“星系密度过高的候选者”，可以帮助解释宇宙的再电离。再电离是指第一批恒星和星系形成并照亮其周围环境，使原始宇宙中的氢原子再电离。 在此之前，宇宙是不透明且黑暗的。此后，光子可以自由旅行，宇宙照亮了。 该研究的标题是“JADES：前 500 迈尔范围内的一个突出的星系超密度候选者”，主要作者是 Zihao Wu。吴来自哈佛大学和史密森尼天体物理中心。 作者写道：“我们在 JWST 高级深河外巡天报告中报告了 z ≈ 10.5 处存在一个星系密度过高的候选星系。”它包含 18 个星系，组成一个共同运动的星系团，排列非常密集。 “星系数密度比场预期高四倍，占相当明亮星系的三分之一，占总恒星形成率（SFR）的近50%”在特定场和GOODS-S场红移中。 与整个区域相比，在这种超密度区域中，更多的星系拥有紧密的伴星和亚结构，作者表示，这是相互作用的证据。 这些星系的恒星质量和恒星形成率要高一些......

reflection.en: The development of the James Webb Space Telescope is a testament to human ingenuity and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. After decades of challenges, its launch and the subsequent discoveries it enables bring glory to the dedication of its creators and inspire awe at the universe's wonders. This endeavor reminds us that the pursuit of understanding,...
reflection.zh: 詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜的建造，是人类智慧和对知识不懈追求的证明。经过数十年的挑战，它的发射及其后续的发现，为创造者的奉献精神增添了光彩，并激发了人们对宇宙奇迹的敬畏之情。 这项事业提醒我们，即使面对巨大的困难，追求理解也是一项崇高的事业，它反映了神圣的、好奇的火花和深刻发现的能力。

verse.textEn: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.
verse.textZh: 将事隐秘乃神的荣耀；将事察清乃君王的荣耀。

title.en: Mass nesting brings swarms of turtles to Mexican beach
title.zh: 大批海龟涌上墨西哥海滩进行筑巢

summary.en: Thousands of olive ridley turtles arrived at La Escobilla beach in Oaxaca, Mexico, within 48 hours to lay their eggs, a phenomenon known as 'la arribada'. This is the sixth wave of nesting this season.
summary.zh: 据保护区官员称，数千只橄榄绿海龟在48小时内抵达墨西哥瓦哈卡州的拉埃斯科比利亚海滩产卵，这一现象被称为“arribada”。这是本季第六波筑巢潮。

body.en:
Thousands of olive ridley turtles came to La Escobilla beach in Oaxaca, Mexico, to lay their eggs within 48 hours, according to sanctuary officials.

The natural phenomenon is known as "la arribada", meaning "the arrival", and sees hundreds of thousands of the reptiles swim ashore in southern Mexico.

This is the sixth wave of the creatures in the nesting season, which started in March.
body.zh: 据保护区官员称，数千只丽龟在 48 小时内来到墨西哥瓦哈卡州的拉埃斯科比拉海滩产卵。 这种自然现象被称为“la arribada”，意思是“到来”，数十万只两栖动物在墨西哥南部游上岸。 这是该生物在三月开始的筑巢季节的第六波。

reflection.en: The arrival of thousands of olive ridley turtles on La Escobilla beach is a powerful reminder of the intricate beauty and cycles of the natural world. It speaks to the profound wisdom and diversity that Yahweh has woven into creation, a testament to His ongoing work. May we pause to appreciate these moments of natural wonder, recognizing them as expressions...
reflection.zh: 数千只橄榄绿海龟抵达拉埃斯科比利亚海滩，是造物主精心设计的自然奇观，提醒我们生命的多样性和雅伟创造的智慧。这“arribada”现象，意为“抵达”，展现了生命周期的力量。 愿我们驻足欣赏这些自然奇迹，认识到它们是创造者艺术和持续力量的体现，并从中获得敬畏和希望。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: A new design for a plasma engine fuels on only thin air
title.zh: 一种只以空气为燃料的等离子发动机新设计

summary.en: A new plasma engine design has been developed that can use atmospheric air as fuel, potentially eliminating the need for expensive propellants like xenon for satellites in very low Earth orbit (VLEO). This innovation addresses the trade-offs of VLEO, where constant thrust is needed to counteract air friction, by...
summary.zh: 一种新的等离子发动机设计已被开发出来，可以使用大气中的空气作为燃料，从而可能消除近地轨道（VLEO）卫星对氙气等昂贵推进剂的需求。这项创新通过提供一种更可持续、更具成本效益的燃料来源，解决了近地轨道（VLEO）的权衡问题，因为在该轨道上需要持续的推力来抵消空气摩擦。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Choosing an orbit for a satellite always comes with trade-offs. Very low Earth orbit (VLEO), between 100–450 km (62–280 miles), has distinct advantages. Remote-sensing cameras can take better pictures, communications and radar require less power, and atmospheric drag automatically cleans up dead satellites.

But there is also a cost—air friction requires satellites in this orbit to use an engine nearly constantly to stay aloft, which in turn requires fuel—typically expensive gases like xenon. So, as part of his Ph.D. thesis at the University of Stuttgart, available on arXiv , Francesco Romano decided to solve that problem by using the air molecules that cause the friction as fuel for a plasma engine to keep satellites aloft indefinitely in VLEO.

His solution falls into a category of atmosphere-breathing electric propulsion (ABEP) systems . These scoop up thin air in front of a spacecraft (or, in some cases, a missile) and channel it into an electric engine, which then turns the molecules into plasma and shoots it out the back, producing thrust. It's easy enough to explain in theory, but in practice, there are difficult technical problems to work around.

The first is atomic oxygen (AO). In the upper atmosphere, UV radiation splits O 2 into this aggressive, single-atom form of the gas that we all need to breathe. AO is notoriously oxidative, corroding metal electrodes, acceleration grids and even the cathodes used in standard Hall thrusters or other types of ion engines.

Perhaps most importantly, AO burns through the cathodes used in the "electron gun" that neutralizes the spacecraft so that the whole thing doesn't become charged and simply suck the charged particles right back to itself, nullifying the thrust they provide. Without that feature, the whole ion-propulsion system fails.

Another difficult feature when designing engines for use in VLEO is the variability of the atmosphere itself. It changes based on the day-night cycle, latitude and even solar activity. Making sure an engine can continually operate in all these different conditions has proven difficult so far.

To solve these problems, Romano developed a contactless, neutralizer-less radio-frequency (RF) helicon plasma thruster and paired it with an optimized atmospheric intake system. Let's tackle the intake system first.

He tested three different versions of an intake. One, called an "enhanced funnel design," acted as a molecular trap to capture air particles that are spread so far apart that they never run into each other. Next, he used a "diffuse intake" with a compact hexagonal design made of a coated...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 选择卫星轨道总是需要权衡。 100-450 公里（62-280 英里）之间的极低地球轨道 (VLEO) 具有明显的优势。遥感相机可以拍摄更好的照片，通信和雷达需要更少的电力，大气阻力可以自动清理失效的卫星。 但这也是有代价的——空气摩擦需要该轨道上的卫星几乎不断地使用发动机来保持在高空，这反过来又需要燃料——通常是昂贵的气体，如氙气。因此，作为他博士学位的一部分。在斯图加特大学的论文（可在 arXiv 上找到）中，Francesco Romano 决定通过使用引起摩擦的空气分子作为等离子发动机的燃料来解决这个问题，从而使卫星在 VLEO 中无限期地保持在高空。 他的解决方案属于呼吸大气电力推进（ABEP）系统的范畴。它们会在航天器（或者在某些情况下是导弹）前面汲取稀薄的空气，并将其引导到电动机中，然后电动机将分子转化为等离子体并将其从后面射出，产生推力。理论上很容易解释，但在实践中，存在一些困难的技术问题需要解决。 第一个是原子氧（AO）。在高层大气中，紫外线辐射将 O 2 分解成我们都需要呼吸的腐蚀性单原子气体。众所周知，AO 会氧化、腐蚀金属电极、加速栅，甚至标准霍尔推进器或其他类型离子发动机中使用的阴极。 也许最重要的是，AO 会烧毁“电子枪”中使用的阴极，从而中和航天器，这样整个物体就不会带电，而只是将带电粒子吸回自身，从而抵消了它们提供的推力。如果没有这个功能，整个离子推进系统就会失败。 设计用于 VLEO 的发动机时的另一个困难是大气本身的变化。它根据昼夜周期、纬度甚至太阳活动而变化。到目前为止，确保发动机能够在所有这些不同的条件下持续运行已被证明是困难的。 为了解决这些问题，罗马诺开发了一种非接触式、无中和剂的射频 (RF) 螺旋等离子体推进器，并将其与优化的大气进气系统配对。我们先来解决进气系统。 他测试了三种不同版本的摄入量。其中一种被称为“增强型漏斗设计”，充当分子陷阱来捕获分散得很远而不会相互碰撞的空气颗粒。接下来，他使用了由涂层制成的紧凑六边形设计的“漫射进气口”...

reflection.en: Engineers have designed a plasma engine that runs on air, a significant innovation for satellite technology. This development reminds us that when we commit our endeavors, like this scientific pursuit, to Yahweh, He can establish our plans and bring them to fruition. It is a testament to human ingenuity guided by a desire to overcome limitations.
reflection.zh: 工程师们设计了一种以空气为动力的等离子发动机，这是卫星技术的一项重大创新。这一发展提醒我们，当我们把我们的努力，比如这项科学追求，托付给雅伟时，祂就能坚定我们的计划并使之实现。这是人类智慧克服局限的愿望的证明。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: US scraps limits on emissions from coal and gas power plants
title.zh: 美国取消对燃煤和燃气发电厂排放的限制

summary.en: The US Environmental Protection Agency has announced the scrapping of regulations designed to limit pollution from coal and gas power plants. The agency stated this move would save billions of dollars and reduce energy prices, while environmental groups warned of significant costs to public health and the planet,...
summary.zh: 美国环保署宣布取消旨在限制燃煤和燃气发电厂污染的法规。该机构表示，此举将节省数十亿美元并降低能源价格，而环保组织则警告将对公众健康和地球造成巨大代价，并预计将面临法律挑战。

body.en:
Rules aimed at limiting pollution from coal and gas power plants are being scrapped, the head of the US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) has announced.

The agency also said it would take steps to prevent future administrations from regulating power plant emissions.

The EPA said that getting rid of the majority of the climate rules from President Joe Biden's era would save $310bn (£223bn) and reduce energy prices.

But environmental groups warned it would come at a huge cost to Americans' health and the planet. The EPA's move is expected to face immediate legal challenges.

"The reality is that America produces energy better and cleaner than anywhere else in the world, and our power plants should not be unfairly targeted," the head of the EPA, Lee Zeldin, said on Monday.

Fossil fuels, which include coal and natural gas, are by far the largest driver of global climate change, according to the United Nations.

The EPA said in a statement that it found the Biden-era rules on power plant emissions had "exceeded the agency's authority".

The agency said the regulations required "control technologies that are not adequately demonstrated, effectively forcing plants to retire rather than setting standards they could actually meet".

The EPA is also seeking to get rid of all other greenhouse gas rules for the power sector.

The changes, which will undergo public scrutiny, were proposed last year by Zeldin.

He said the new rules would "ensure affordable and reliable energy supplies and drive down the costs of transportation, heating, utilities, farming, and manufacturing while boosting our national security".

The Biden-era regulations called for a major reduction in carbon emissions from power plants, as well as vehicles and industrial facilities. It was estimated that the measures would stop 4,500 premature deaths annually.

But the EPA said on Monday: "Any potential public health harms are too uncertain, conjectural, remote, and convoluted to tie specifically to the US power sector."

Zeldin told reporters that safeguards against "hazardous air pollutants" would remain in place "to safeguard human health".

Nathaniel Keohane, president of the Center for Climate and Energy Solutions – an independent environmental organisation – described the move as "a giant step backward".

"In repealing carbon pollution standards for power plants, EPA has ignored sound science and economics and abdicated its responsibility to protect public health and welfare," Keohane added.

The US is currently the second-biggest emitter of planet-warming greenhouse gases, such as carbon dioxide, behind China.

And the power sector makes up about a quarter of US emissions, at roughly 1.5 billion tonnes of carbon dioxide-equivalent each year, according to the latest available...
body.zh: 美国环境保护署（EPA）负责人宣布，旨在限制燃煤和天然气发电厂污染的规定将被废除。 该机构还表示，将采取措施阻止未来政府监管发电厂排放。 美国环保局表示，废除乔·拜登总统时代的大部分气候规则将节省 3100 亿美元（2230 亿英镑）并降低能源价格。 但环保组织警告称，这将使美国人的健康和地球付出巨大代价。环保局的举动预计将立即面临法律挑战。 美国环保局局长李·泽尔丁周一表示：“现实情况是，美国生产的能源比世界上其他任何地方都更好、更清洁，我们的发电厂不应该成为不公平的目标。” 据联合国称，包括煤炭和天然气在内的化石燃料是迄今为止全球气候变化的最大驱动因素。 美国环保署在一份声明中表示，它发现拜登时代关于发电厂排放的规定“超出了该机构的权限”。 该机构表示，这些法规要求“控制未充分论证的技术，实际上迫使工厂退役，而不是制定它们实际可以达到的标准”。 美国环保署还寻求废除电力行业的所有其他温室气体规则。 这些变化是泽尔丁去年提出的，将接受公众监督。 他表示，新规则将“确保负担得起且可靠的能源供应，降低运输、供暖、公用事业、农业和制造业的成本，同时增强我们的国家安全”。 拜登时代的法规要求大幅减少发电厂、车辆和工业设施的碳排放。据估计，这些措施每年将阻止 4,500 人过早死亡。 但美国环保局周一表示：“任何潜在的公共健康危害都过于不确定、推测、遥远且复杂，无法与美国电力部门具体联系起来。” 泽尔丁告诉记者，针对“有害空气污染物”的防范措施将继续存在，“以保障人类健康”。 独立环境组织气候与能源解决方案中心主席纳撒尼尔·基欧汉 (Nathaniel Keohane) 称此举是“巨大的倒退”。 基欧汉补充说：“在废除发电厂碳污染标准的过程中，美国环保局忽视了合理的科学和经济学，并放弃了保护公众健康和福利的责任。” 美国目前是二氧化碳等全球变暖温室气体的第二大排放国，仅次于中国。 根据最新的可用数据，电力行业约占美国排放量的四分之一，每年排放约 15 亿吨二氧化碳当量……

reflection.en: The decision to dismantle environmental protections in favor of economic savings raises profound questions about stewardship and justice. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God. This directive challenges leaders and citizens alike to consider the long-term well-being of creation and its inhabitants, not just immediate...
reflection.zh: 为追求经济效益而拆除环境保护措施的决定，引发了关于管理和公义的深刻问题。弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯，并以谦卑的心与我们的雅伟同行。这一指示要求领导者和公民都必须考虑长远的福祉，不仅是眼前的经济利益，也包括对受造界及其居民的责任。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Flash flooding interrupts half-marathon, submerges cars
title.zh: 洪水突袭半程马拉松，汽车被淹

summary.en: Parts of New York, New Jersey and Connecticut were hit by flash flooding, leading to water rescues, stranded motorists and half-marathon runners battling the floodwaters. Connecticut officials said parts of the state saw up to seven inches of rain in a very short period of time, according to the BBC's partner, CBS...
summary.zh: 纽约、新泽西和康涅狄格州的部分地区遭遇了山洪暴发，导致了水上救援、车辆滞留以及半程马拉松选手在洪水中艰难前行。据英国广播公司（BBC）的合作伙伴CBS新闻报道，康涅狄格州官员称该州部分地区在极短时间内降雨量高达七英寸。

body.en: Parts of New York, New Jersey and Connecticut were hit by flash flooding leading to water rescues, stranded motorists and half-marathon runners struggling through waist-deep flood waters. Connecticut officials said parts of the state saw up to seven inches of rain in a very short period of time, according to the BBC's partner, CBS News.
body.zh: 纽约、新泽西和康涅狄格州部分地区遭受山洪袭击，导致水上救援、被困的驾车者和半程马拉松运动员在齐腰深的洪水中挣扎。据 BBC 合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司新闻报道，康涅狄格州官员表示，该州部分地区在很短的时间内降雨量高达 7 英寸。

reflection.en: The sudden and intense flash flooding in New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut brought chaos and danger, submerging cars and forcing runners to battle waist-deep water. In moments of overwhelming natural disaster, when the earth itself seems to shift, we are reminded that Yahweh is our refuge and strength, a help readily found in times of distress. May...
reflection.zh: 纽约、新泽西和康涅狄格州突如其来的强烈山洪暴发带来了混乱和危险，淹没了汽车，迫使跑者在齐腰深的水中艰难前行。在压倒性的自然灾害面前，当大地似乎都在动摇时，我们被提醒雅伟是我们的避难所和力量，是在患难中随时可得的帮助。 愿受影响的人们找到安全并迅速恢复。面对如此强大的力量，我们可以转向神圣的慰藉和力量，即使脚下的土地不稳定，也能信靠那依然坚定的存在。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Cancer is rising in younger adults. Faster biological aging may help explain why
title.zh: 癌症在年轻成年人中上升。更快的生物衰老可能有助于解释原因

summary.en: Cancer rates are increasing among adults under 55, with new research suggesting that accelerated biological aging might be a contributing factor. Studies indicate that individuals from more recent generations tend to exhibit biological ages older than those from earlier generations at the same chronological age, and...
summary.zh: 55岁以下成年人的癌症发病率正在上升，新的研究表明生物衰老加速可能是其中的一个因素。研究表明，与同一实际年龄的人相比，来自较近几代人的个体的生物年龄往往比来自较早几代人的个体更年长，而这种加速衰老与早发性癌症的风险增加有关。

body.en: Cancer rates are rising in adults under 55, and new research suggests accelerated biological aging may be one piece of the puzzle. Scientists found that people from more recent generations tended to have bodies that appeared biologically older than those of earlier generations at the same chronological age. Greater biological age acceleration was linked to a higher risk of early onset cancers, with specific patterns seen for lung, gastrointestinal, uterine and colorectal cancers.
body.zh: 55 岁以下成年人的癌症发病率正在上升，新的研究表明生物衰老加速可能是造成这一难题的原因之一。科学家发现，近几代人的身体往往比同年龄的前几代人的身体显得更老。生物年龄的加快与早发癌症的风险增加有关，肺癌、胃肠道癌、子宫癌和结直肠癌具有特定的模式。

reflection.en: The news of rising cancer rates in younger adults, linked to accelerated biological aging, prompts reflection on our finite time. Psalm 90:12 reminds us, 'Teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.' This call to mindfulness encourages us to live with purpose, recognizing the preciousness of each moment.
reflection.zh: 年轻成年人癌症发病率上升的消息，与生物衰老加速有关，促使我们反思生命的有限。诗篇90:12提醒我们：“求你教我们数算自己的日子，好叫我们得着智慧的心。” 这呼吁我们活在当下，认识到每个时刻的宝贵，并以智慧度日。

verse.textEn: Teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
verse.textZh: 求你指教我们怎样数算自己的日子，好叫我们得着智慧的心。

title.en: Hidden brain wiring may help keep the mind sharp as gray matter shrinks
title.zh: 隐藏的大脑线路可能有助于在灰质萎缩时保持思维敏锐

summary.en: Scientists have discovered that the brain’s short-range wiring may help protect cognition even as gray matter shrinks with age. Healthier connections just beneath the brain’s surface were linked to better language skills and appeared to weaken the impact of gray matter loss.
summary.zh: 科学家发现，大脑的短程线路可能有助于保护认知功能，即使随着年龄增长灰质萎缩。大脑表面下方更健康的连接与更好的语言技能相关，并似乎削弱了灰质损失的影响。

body.en:
Scientists at the Mark and Mary Stevens Neuroimaging and Informatics Institute (Stevens INI) at the Keck School of Medicine of USC have uncovered evidence that two neighboring types of brain tissue may work together to support thinking abilities later in life. Their findings suggest that the condition of the brain's local communication pathways could influence how strongly gray matter loss affects cognition.

The study, published in Alzheimer's & Dementia: The Journal of the Alzheimer's Association , included brain imaging and cognitive testing from 459 adults aged 60 and older living in communities across India. The research is among the first to investigate superficial white matter in a community-based population from a low- and middle-income country.

Superficial white matter forms a thin layer of nerve fibers directly beneath the gray matter covering the outside of the brain. These short, curved fibers connect nearby regions of the cerebral cortex, allowing them to exchange information. They can be thought of as local roads linking neighboring areas of the brain.

Gray matter serves a different role. It contains many of the nerve cells responsible for processing information. Together, gray matter and the white matter directly beneath it form closely connected systems that may both contribute to cognitive health.

"Gray matter and superficial white matter are physically close and may play different roles: gray matter processes information, while superficial white matter helps nearby brain regions communicate," said Yingxu Liu, PhD, a postdoctoral scholar at the Stevens INI and first author of the study. "Our findings suggest that cognitive health depends not only on how much gray matter is preserved, but also on the condition of the wiring that connects it."

To investigate these local connections, the researchers used an advanced type of diffusion MRI. This imaging technique tracks the movement of water through brain tissue, allowing scientists to examine microscopic features that conventional brain scans may not reveal.

The researchers focused on measurements related to neurite density and the amount of freely moving water surrounding these structures. Neurites are the small projections through which nerve cells send and receive signals. A lower density of neurites or an increase in free water can indicate damage or disruption in tissue associated with processes including loss of myelin, inflammation, or swelling.

Participants also underwent assessments covering several areas of cognition, including language, memory, executive function, and visuospatial ability.

The most consistent connection between superficial white matter health and cognitive performance involved language. People with healthier superficial white matter tended to perform...
body.zh: 南加州大学凯克医学院马克和玛丽史蒂文斯神经影像和信息学研究所 (Stevens INI) 的科学家们发现了证据，表明两种相邻类型的脑组织可能共同作用来支持晚年的思维能力。他们的研究结果表明，大脑局部通讯路径的状况可能会影响灰质损失对认知的影响程度。 这项研究发表在《阿尔茨海默氏症与痴呆症：阿尔茨海默氏症协会杂志》上，对居住在印度各地社区的 459 名 60 岁及以上成年人进行了脑成像和认知测试。该研究是首批调查低收入和中等收入国家社区人群浅表白质的研究之一。 浅层白质在覆盖大脑外部的灰质正下方形成一层薄薄的神经纤维。这些短而弯曲的纤维连接大脑皮层的附近区域，使它们能够交换信息。它们可以被认为是连接大脑相邻区域的局部道路。 灰质起着不同的作用。它包含许多负责处理信息的神经细胞。灰质和其正下方的白质一起形成紧密相连的系统，可能都有助于认知健康。 “灰质和浅层白质在物理上很接近，并且可能发挥不同的作用：灰质处理信息，而浅层白质帮助附近的大脑区域进行交流，”史蒂文斯 INI 的博士后学者、该研究的第一作者 Yingxu Liu 博士说。 “我们的研究结果表明，认知健康不仅取决于灰质的保留量，还取决于连接灰质的线路状况。” 为了研究这些局部联系，研究人员使用了一种先进的扩散 MRI。这种成像技术跟踪水在脑组织中的运动，使科学家能够检查传统脑部扫描可能无法揭示的微观特征。 研究人员重点关注与神经突密度和这些结构周围自由移动的水量相关的测量。神经突是神经细胞发送和接收信号的小突起。神经突密度降低或游离水增加可能表明与髓磷脂损失、炎症或肿胀等过程相关的组织损伤或破坏。 参与者还接受了涵盖多个认知领域的评估，包括语言、记忆、执行功能和视觉空间能力。 表层白质健康与认知表现之间最一致的联系涉及语言。具有健康表层白质的人往往表现......

reflection.en: The intricate design of the human brain, with its hidden pathways supporting function even in decline, points to a Creator who has woven profound wisdom into the fabric of life. Observing such complexity in nature can lead us to greater understanding and awe of Yahweh's handiwork.
reflection.zh: 人类大脑错综复杂的设计，其隐藏的通路即使在衰退中也能支持功能，这指向了一位将深刻智慧编织入生命之中的创造者。观察自然界如此复杂的结构，可以引导我们对雅伟的创造有更深的理解和敬畏。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Chemistry textbooks have been getting this wrong for nearly 100 years
title.zh: 化学教科书近100年来可能一直出错

summary.en: A fundamental chemistry concept taught for nearly a century may be incorrect, according to new research. Scientists propose that the inductive effect in neutral molecules extends only across one bond, not several as previously believed, which could simplify organic chemistry and foster innovation.
summary.zh: 根据一项新研究，近一个世纪以来教授的一个基础化学概念可能是不正确的。科学家们提出，中性分子中的诱导效应仅延伸过一个化学键，而非如先前认为的那样延伸过三四个键，这可能会简化有机化学并促进创新。

body.en: A foundational chemistry concept found in textbooks for almost 100 years may have been taught incorrectly. Researchers say the inductive effect in neutral molecules appears to extend only across one chemical bond, rather than gradually weakening over three or four bonds as traditionally taught. The team argues that updating this explanation could make organic chemistry easier to understand and provide a stronger foundation for future research and innovation.
body.zh: 近 100 年来教科书上出现的基本化学概念可能一直被错误地教授。研究人员表示，中性分子中的诱导效应似乎仅在一个化学键上延伸，而不是像传统教导的那样在三个或四个化学键上逐渐减弱。该团队认为，更新这一解释可以使有机化学更容易理解，并为未来的研究和创新提供更坚实的基础。

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge is a noble endeavor, and this story highlights how dedicated researchers can refine our understanding of the world. Even foundational concepts can be re-examined, leading to clearer explanations and new avenues for discovery. This persistent quest for truth mirrors the biblical idea that uncovering hidden things brings glory.
reflection.zh: 求知是一项崇高的事业，这个故事强调了敬业的研究人员如何能够完善我们对世界的理解。即使是基础概念也可以被重新审视，从而带来更清晰的解释和新的发现途径。这种对真理的不懈追求，呼应了圣经中揭示隐藏之事带来荣耀的理念。

verse.textEn: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.
verse.textZh: 将事隐秘乃神的荣耀；将事察清乃君王的荣耀。

title.en: Crocodiles are famous for finding their way home. These ones didn’t
title.zh: 鳄鱼以回家闻名。这些鳄鱼却不然

summary.en: Saltwater crocodiles raised in captivity and released into Bangladesh’s Sundarbans surprised scientists by settling into the wild rather than attempting to return to their breeding facility. This finding suggests that releasing larger, mature captive crocodiles could aid in restoring depleted populations.
summary.zh: 在孟加拉国孙德尔本斯释放的圈养咸水鳄鱼，出乎科学家意料地适应了野外生活，而不是试图返回它们的繁殖地。这一发现表明，释放更大、更成熟的圈养鳄鱼可能有助于恢复数量减少的种群。

body.en:
A new study suggests that saltwater crocodiles born or raised in captivity may not try to return to their breeding centers once they are released into the wild. The finding could help conservationists improve efforts to restore declining crocodile populations.

Finding the way back home is an important behavior across the animal kingdom. For many species, it can play a major role in survival and reproduction. Some animals make short daily trips back to nests or burrows after searching for food, while others navigate across vast distances over weeks or months.

"Crocodilians, the largest predators in most tropical, subtropical freshwater and brackish environments, are a unique case when it comes to homing behavior," said behavioral ecologist and Adjunct Associate Professor Ru Somaweera, from Murdoch University.

"Crocodiles are remarkably good at finding their way home, often returning to their original capture sites and limiting the success of relocation programs. What we still don't fully understand, though, is how this behavior plays out in individuals that have been bred or kept in captivity for long periods before being released back into the wild."

Researchers carried out the study in the Sundarbans mangrove forest in Bangladesh, one of the country's last major refuges for saltwater crocodiles. Heavy commercial hunting for crocodile skins severely reduced the species in Bangladesh until the 1970s. Although saltwater crocodiles have been legally protected there since 1973, their numbers have shown no measurable recovery.

Most of the country's remaining known crocodiles are now found in the Sundarbans. Even there, the population is small, with the most recent survey estimating just 140 mature individuals.

"If crocodiles who are bred and raised in captivity subsequently return to their enclosures or breeding facilities after being released, attempts to reintroduce them into the wild as part of conservation efforts will ultimately fail," Associate Professor Somaweera said.

"The traditional approach has been to use hatchlings in reintroduction programs, but their survival rates are extremely low and they take a long time to reach reproductive maturity. Understanding whether larger, captive-bred crocodiles can be used instead represents an important knowledge gap."

To investigate, the researchers fitted five mature saltwater crocodiles with satellite tracking devices. The group included three captive-reared females that had spent 8-22 years in captivity, one local wild crocodile that was captured and then released at the same site, and another wild crocodile that was moved (translocated) a long distance from where it had been caught.

According to Associate Professor Somaweera, the most encouraging result involved the three captive-reared...
body.zh: 一项新的研究表明，圈养出生或饲养的咸水鳄鱼一旦被释放到野外，可能不会试图返回它们的繁殖中心。这一发现可以帮助自然资源保护主义者加大努力，恢复日益减少的鳄鱼数量。 寻找回家的路是整个动物王国的一个重要行为。对于许多物种来说，它可以在生存和繁殖中发挥重要作用。有些动物在寻找食物后每天都会短途返回巢穴或洞穴，而另一些动物则需要数周或数月的时间才能穿越很远的距离。 默多克大学的行为生态学家兼兼职副教授 Ru Somaweera 表示：“鳄鱼是大多数热带、亚热带淡水和咸水环境中最大的掠食者，在归巢行为方面是一个独特的例子。” “鳄鱼非常擅长找到回家的路，经常返回原来的捕获地点，这限制了重新安置计划的成功。不过，我们仍然不完全了解的是，这种行为在被放回野外之前被饲养或长期圈养的个体中是如何发挥作用的。” 研究人员在孟加拉国的孙德尔本斯红树林进行了这项研究，这里是该国最后的咸水鳄鱼主要保护区之一。直到 20 世纪 70 年代，对鳄鱼皮的大量商业狩猎严重减少了孟加拉国的鳄鱼数量。尽管咸水鳄鱼自 1973 年以来就受到法律保护，但它们的数量却没有出现明显的恢复。 该国现存的大多数已知鳄鱼现在都在孙德尔本斯发现。即使在那里，种群数量也很少，最近的调查估计只有 140 只成年个体。 索马维拉副教授说：“如果人工饲养的鳄鱼在被释放后返回其围栏或饲养设施，作为保护工作的一部分将它们重新引入野外的尝试最终将失败。” “传统的方法是在放归计划中使用刚孵化的鳄鱼，但它们的存活率极低，而且需要很长时间才能达到生殖成熟。了解是否可以使用更大的圈养鳄鱼来代替，代表着一个重要的知识差距。” 为了进行调查，研究人员给五只成熟的咸水鳄鱼安装了卫星跟踪装置。该群体包括三只人工饲养的雌性鳄鱼，它们被圈养了8-22年；一只是捕获后在同一地点释放的当地野生鳄鱼；另一只野生鳄鱼是从捕获地点转移（易位）很远的地方。 索马维拉副教授表示，最令人鼓舞的结果涉及三只圈养的……

reflection.en: The natural world holds profound lessons, often surprising us when we observe it closely. These crocodiles, expected to return home, instead demonstrated an unexpected adaptability to their new environment. This reminds us that wisdom can be found not only in our plans but also in the quiet, observable truths of creation, as Job noted that even the beasts...
reflection.zh: 大自然蕴含着深刻的教训，当我们仔细观察它时，常常会给我们带来惊喜。这些鳄鱼本应回到家园，却展现出对新环境出人意料的适应能力。这提醒我们，智慧不仅在于我们的计划，也在于被造物中那些安静、可观察的真理，正如约伯所指出的，连牲畜走兽和空中的飞鸟都能教导我们。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Scientists find nine new sponge species in glimpse of Alaska’s deep-sea diversity
title.zh: 科学家在阿拉斯加深海发现九种新海绵物种，一窥其多样性

summary.en: Scientists have discovered nine new species of deep-sea sponges in Alaska, contributing to our understanding of the region's largely unexplored marine biodiversity. These findings expand the known sponge species count in Alaska to 232, but their habitat faces threats from bottom trawling and potential seafloor mining.
summary.zh: 科学家在阿拉斯加发现了九种新的深海海绵物种，增进了我们对该地区未充分探索的海洋生物多样性的认识。这些发现使阿拉斯加已知的海绵物种数量增至232种，但它们的栖息地正面临海底拖网捕捞和潜在的海底采矿的威胁。

body.en: But their habitat is threatened by bottom trawling in the region and Trump’s plan to expand seafloor mining Scientists have discovered nine new deep-sea sponge species off Alaska, offering new insights into the region’s largely unexplored marine biodiversity. The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (Noaa) announced the discovery on Thursday, saying the species were found in the Gulf of Alaska and the Aleutian Islands. The findings bring the total number of known sponge species in Alaska to 232. Continue reading...
body.zh: 但它们的栖息地受到该地区海底拖网捕捞和特朗普扩大海底采矿计划的威胁。科学家们在阿拉斯加附近发现了九种新的深海海绵物种，为该地区基本上未经探索的海洋生物多样性提供了新的见解。美国国家海洋和大气管理局（Noaa）周四宣布了这一发现，称该物种是在阿拉斯加湾和阿留申群岛发现的。这些发现使阿拉斯加已知的海绵物种总数达到 232 种。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The deep sea, a realm of mystery and wonder, continues to reveal Yahweh's intricate artistry. The discovery of these nine new sponge species reminds us of the vastness of creation and the profound wisdom inherent in its design. Even as these fragile ecosystems face threats, their existence points to the Creator's boundless creativity and the importance of...
reflection.zh: 深海，一个充满神秘和奇迹的领域，不断揭示雅伟那精妙的艺术。这九种新海绵物种的发现提醒我们造物的浩瀚以及其中蕴含的深刻智慧。即使这些脆弱的生态系统面临威胁，它们的存在也彰显了造物主无限的创造力，以及珍视祂所造生命的意义。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Starwatch: A Venus-spotting challenge with a beautiful reward
title.zh: 观星：一次挑战与美丽的回报

summary.en: This week's Starwatch feature presents a challenge: spotting the planet Venus in the early evening sky. On Monday, Venus will appear close to a young, thinly illuminated crescent moon, offering a beautiful celestial pairing for those who can find it.
summary.zh: 本周的观星指南提出了一项挑战：在傍晚时分寻找金星。周一，金星将与一弯细细的月牙近距离相伴，为成功找到它的人们带来美丽的星空景象。

body.en: The bright planet and the young crescent moon will make an attractive pairing on Monday evening This week’s Starwatch is a challenge but a beautiful reward awaits for anyone who succeeds. The question is: how early in the evening can we find Venus? On Monday, the bright planet has a close encounter with a young crescent moon. The moon will be just over three days old with about 14% of its visible surface illuminated. Unfortunately for UK observers, the two make their closest approach during daylight, passing within a moon’s width of one another around lunchtime. Continue reading...
body.zh: 这颗明亮的行星和年轻的新月将在周一晚上形成一对有吸引力的配对。本周的观星活动是一项挑战，但任何成功的人都会得到丰厚的奖励。问题是：晚上多久我们才能找到金星？周一，这颗明亮的行星与一颗年轻的新月亲密接触。月球诞生仅三天多一点，其可见表面的约 14% 会被照亮。对于英国观察者来说不幸的是，两者在白天最接近，在午餐时间彼此擦肩而过，距离只有一个月亮的宽度。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The vastness of the cosmos, with planets like Venus and the moon tracing their paths, is a constant testament to the Creator's artistry. Even when spotting them presents a challenge, the reward is a glimpse of the heavens declaring the glory of Yahweh. May we find moments to look up, to marvel at the order and beauty above, and to remember the One who...
reflection.zh: 浩瀚的宇宙，金星和月亮循着它们的轨迹运行，是造物主艺术性的永恒见证。即使寻找它们充满挑战，但回报是瞥见那宣告雅伟荣耀的穹苍。 愿我们能找到片刻抬头仰望，惊叹于上方的秩序与美丽，并记念那安排这一切的祂。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: Encoded and non-genetic protein variants expand human functional proteome
title.zh: 编码和非遗传蛋白质变体扩展了人类功能蛋白质组

summary.en: A new study published in Nature introduces encoded and non-genetic protein variants that significantly expand the human functional proteome. This research opens new avenues for understanding human biology and potential therapeutic interventions.
summary.zh: 发表在《自然》杂志上的一项新研究介绍了编码和非遗传蛋白质变体，它们极大地扩展了人类功能蛋白质组。这项研究为理解人类生物学和潜在的治疗干预开辟了新途径。

reflection.en: The relentless pursuit of knowledge, as seen in this scientific advancement, reflects a deep human drive to understand the intricate workings of creation. As our understanding grows, may we also cultivate the wisdom to use this knowledge for good, honoring the complexity of life itself.
reflection.zh: 科学进步中体现出的对知识的不懈追求，反映了人类理解受造物复杂运作的深层驱动力。随着我们理解的加深，愿我们也培养智慧，将这些知识用于善事，并尊重生命本身的复杂性。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: The roots of astrology, the mysterious nature of time and more: Books in brief
title.zh: 占星术的根源、时间的神秘本质等：书籍精选

summary.en: Andrew Robinson reviews five of the best science picks from Nature, covering topics such as the origins of astrology, the mysterious nature of time, and other scientific subjects.
summary.zh: Andrew Robinson 评选了《自然》杂志的五本最佳科学读物，内容涵盖占星术的起源、时间的神秘本质以及其他科学主题。

reflection.en: The relentless pursuit of knowledge, as highlighted in these science book reviews, mirrors the prophetic insight that in the end times, 'knowledge will increase.' This surge of understanding, whether about the cosmos or the human mind, calls us to seek wisdom alongside information, discerning truth in an ever-expanding sea of data. As we delve deeper into...
reflection.zh: 这些科学书籍评论所突显的对知识的不懈追求，恰如预言中所述，在末世“知识必增长”。这种对理解力的激增，无论是关于宇宙还是人类心智，都呼唤我们在信息爆炸的时代寻求智慧，在不断扩展的数据海洋中辨别真理。 当我们深入探索时间和宇宙的奥秘时，愿我们牢记，真正的智慧来自上方，以谦卑和敬畏之心引导我们的探索。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: How is climate change affecting conifers and their ability to sequester carbon?
title.zh: 气候变化如何影响针叶树及其固碳能力？

summary.en: New research indicates that a combination of factors may influence the growth of conifer trees, potentially affecting their capacity to sequester carbon.
summary.zh: 新研究表明，多种因素的相互作用可能会影响针叶树的生长，从而影响它们固碳的能力。

reflection.en: The intricate balance of ecosystems, like the one described concerning conifers and carbon sequestration, reveals the profound wisdom woven into creation. As climate change disrupts these systems, we are reminded of our role as stewards, called to understand and protect the Earth's diverse life.
reflection.zh: 生态系统的复杂平衡，例如文中关于针叶树和固碳的描述，彰显了创造中蕴含的深邃智慧。随着气候变化扰乱这些系统，我们被提醒要作为管家，理解并保护地球上多样的生命。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: The pet trade puts reptiles and amphibians at risk: close legal gaps now
title.zh: 宠物贸易危及爬行动物和两栖动物：立即堵塞法律漏洞

summary.en: Patchy legislation means that animals are routinely taken from their natural habitats and sold in other countries. Fresh national and international measures could help to stop this exploitation.
summary.zh: 零散的立法意味着动物经常被从自然栖息地捕获并在其他国家出售。新的国家和国际措施可以帮助制止这种剥削。

reflection.en: The global pet trade, driven by demand for exotic species, often leads to the unsustainable removal of reptiles and amphibians from their native environments. This practice leaves these creatures vulnerable and voiceless in the face of exploitation. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to speak for those who cannot speak for themselves, urging us to defend the rights...
reflection.zh: 全球宠物贸易，由对奇异物种的需求驱动，常常导致爬行动物和两栖动物在其原生环境中被不可持续地捕获。这种做法使这些生物在面临剥削时变得脆弱且无声。箴言31:8-9呼吁我们为不能自辩的开口，为一切孤苦人伸冤，为他们辩屈。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Donor-funded science is rising in Brazil ― upending a long tradition
title.zh: 巴西捐助者资助的科学正在兴起——颠覆了悠久的传统

summary.en: Philanthropists are stepping up support for research in Brazil, a country where scientists have historically relied solely on government funding. This shift marks a departure from a long-standing tradition and introduces new avenues for scientific advancement.
summary.zh: 在巴西，慈善家们正在加大对科研的支持力度，而这个国家在历史上一直仅依赖政府资助。这一转变标志着对一项悠久传统的偏离，并为科学进步开辟了新的途径。

reflection.en: In Brazil, a nation long accustomed to government-funded research, a new era is dawning as philanthropists increasingly step in to support scientific endeavors. This shift reflects a growing recognition of the value of knowledge and the diverse ways it can be cultivated. The pursuit of understanding, whether through public or private means, is a testament...
reflection.zh: 在巴西，这个长期以来习惯于政府资助科研的国家，随着慈善家们日益介入支持科学事业，一个新时代正在到来。这一转变反映了对知识价值日益增长的认识，以及培育知识的多种途径。对理解的追求，无论通过公共还是私人途径，都证明了人类的好奇心和揭示世界运作方式的愿望。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: Technology Desk
title.zh: 科技前沿

strap.en: Technology shaping how we live, work, and think.
strap.zh: 正在改变生活、工作与思考方式的科技动态。

title.en: AI safety requires more than just slowing our pace | Stuart Russell
title.zh: 人工智能安全不仅仅是放慢脚步

summary.en: The rapid development of artificial intelligence has led to a high-stakes debate about safety requirements, with researchers resigning and "AI doomsday" discussions intensifying. The author argues that safety is non-negotiable and depends on meeting concrete goals, not merely adjusting timelines.
summary.zh: 人工智能的快速发展引发了关于安全要求的高风险辩论，研究人员辞职，并且“人工智能末日”的讨论日益激烈。作者认为安全是不可谈判的，并且取决于实现具体目标，而不仅仅是调整时间表。

body.en: Safety requirements are non-negotiable. They depend on meeting concrete goals, not just adjusting a timeline It has been a week of high drama in AI, precipitated by the resignation of the AI safety researcher Jacob Coxon from Anthropic. This followed several weeks of increasingly lurid and disturbing revelations about the OpenAI/Hugging Face incident. My inbox yesterday included a message from Business Insider with the subject line: “AI doomsday debate reaches boiling point”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 安全要求是不容谈判的。它们依赖于实现具体目标，而不仅仅是调整时间表。人工智能安全研究员 Jacob Coxon 从 Anthropic 辞职，这是人工智能领域充满戏剧性的一周。在此之前的几周，有关 OpenAI/Hugging Face 事件的披露越来越耸人听闻、令人不安。昨天我的收件箱中包含一条来自《商业内幕》的消息，其主题行是：“人工智能世界末日辩论达到沸点”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The current frenzy around AI development, marked by resignations and urgent debates, mirrors the ancient wisdom that rapid advancement and public attention can be a crucible for character. As we push the boundaries of technology, the true test lies not just in what we can create, but in the integrity and foresight we bring to the process, ensuring our...
reflection.zh: 当前围绕人工智能发展的狂热，伴随着辞职和紧迫的辩论，呼应了古老的智慧：快速的进步和公众的关注可以成为品格的试金石。当我们拓展技术的边界时，真正的考验不仅在于我们能创造什么，还在于我们在此过程中所展现的正直和远见，确保我们的创造物能服务于人类的福祉。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Why a decade of doomsday warnings failed to slow the AI race
title.zh: 人工智能竞赛十年警告未能减缓其发展的原因

summary.en: Despite warnings from prominent figures like Stephen Hawking and a viral resignation from an Anthropic researcher citing imminent human extinction, the pursuit of artificial intelligence has continued unabated for over a decade, even as generative AI features like ChatGPT have become publicly accessible.
summary.zh: 尽管斯蒂芬·霍金等知名人士发出警告，并且一位人类灭绝迫在眉睫的Anthropic研究员辞职引发病毒式传播，但人工智能的追求仍在继续，已持续十多年，甚至像ChatGPT这样的生成式AI功能也已向公众开放。

body.en: From Stephen Hawking to Jacob Coxon’s viral Anthropic resignation, fears that AI could threaten humanity have shaken the industry without stopping its pursuit Before an Anthropic researcher resigned and declared human extinction imminent last week, tech leaders and scientists had sounded the alarm about a superintelligent AI ending humanity for over a decade. The development of artificial intelligence “could spell the end of the human race”, warned professor and astrophysicist Stephen Hawking in 2014 – a little less than a decade before the public got its hands on the generative AI features of the original version of ChatGPT. Continue reading...
body.zh: 从史蒂芬·霍金（Stephen Hawking）到雅各布·考克森（Jacob Coxon）病毒般的人择辞职，对人工智能可能威胁人类的担忧震动了整个行业，并没有停止其追求。上周，在一位人择研究人员辞职并宣布人类即将灭绝之前，科技领袖和科学家们十多年来一直对超级智能人工智能终结人类发出警报。教授兼天体物理学家史蒂芬·霍金 (Stephen Hawking) 在 2014 年警告说，人工智能的发展“可能意味着人类的终结”——距离公众接触到原始版 ChatGPT 的生成式人工智能功能还不到十年。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The relentless pace of AI development, marked by increasing knowledge and capabilities, echoes the ancient prophecy in Daniel 12:4: 'But you, Daniel, shut up the words and seal the book, until the time of the end. Many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' As humanity races forward, it is a timely reminder to seek wisdom and ethical guidance...
reflection.zh: 人工智能发展的无情步伐，以知识和能力的增长为标志，呼应了但以理书12:4中的古老预言：“但你，但以理啊，要封闭这些话，盖上书，直到末时。必有许多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。” 随着人类飞速前进，这是一个及时提醒，在技术进步的同时也要寻求智慧和道德指引。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Volvo increases the batteries for 2028 XC60 and XC90 plug-in refresh
title.zh: 沃尔沃为2028年XC60和XC90插电式混合动力车型更新提升了电池续航

summary.en: Volvo has refreshed its XC60 and XC90 plug-in hybrid SUVs, significantly increasing their electric range and updating infotainment systems. The XC60, a bestseller for the brand, receives subtle styling changes alongside the powertrain improvements.
summary.zh: 沃尔沃更新了其XC60和XC90插电式混合动力SUV，显著增加了电动续航里程并更新了信息娱乐系统。作为该品牌畅销车型，XC60在动力系统改进的同时也获得了细微的造型调整。

body.en: Volvo provided flights from Washington, DC, to London, England, and accommodation so Ars could see its refreshed vehicles. Ars does not accept paid editorial content. There must be a case of upgrade fever taking hold in Gothenburg. Yesterday, we saw the revised Volvo XC40 ; today it’s the turn of another pair of Volvo SUVs, the bestselling XC60 and the three-row XC90. While the styling changes are more subtle, the new plug-in hybrid powertrain—which more than doubles its real-world electric range—is most welcome. Volvo had sold more than 2.7 million XC60s worldwide by the end of last year, so it’s an important car for the brand. Visually, there are changes to the “Thor’s Hammer” headlights: these keep their distinctive daylight running light signature but now hide matrix LED projectors within their depths. There’s a new front grille as well, one that has been slimmed down a little, together with tweaks to the bumpers, wings, and some other body panels. On the inside, there’s a new ventilated leather interior option, and like the XC40, the new 11.2-inch infotainment system sports a Gemini personal assistant to enable conversational voice control of the android automotive OS-based infotainment system. Based on some brief testing, the new Gemini voice assistant does at least perform a lot better than the previous version, which, if anything, has degraded in ability over the past few years. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 沃尔沃提供了从华盛顿特区飞往英国伦敦的航班，并提供住宿，以便 Ars 能够看到其更新的车辆。 Ars 不接受付费编辑内容。哥德堡一定有升级热潮。昨天，我们看到了改款的沃尔沃XC40；今天轮到另一款沃尔沃 SUV：最畅销的 XC60 和三排座 XC90。虽然造型变化更加微妙，但新的插电式混合动力系统（其实际电动续航里程增加了一倍多）最受欢迎。截至去年底，沃尔沃XC60在全球的销量已超过270万辆，因此它对该品牌来说是一款重要的汽车。从视觉上看，“雷神之锤”头灯发生了变化：保留了其独特的日间行车灯标志，但现在将矩阵 LED 投影仪隐藏在其深处。还有一个新的前格栅，它已经缩小了一点，同时对保险杠、机翼和其他一些车身面板进行了调整。在内部，有一个新的通风皮革内饰选项，与 XC40 一样，新的 11.2 英寸信息娱乐系统配备了 Gemini 个人助理，可以对基于 Android 汽车操作系统的信息娱乐系统进行对话式语音控制。根据一些简短的测试，新的 Gemini 语音助手的性能至少比之前的版本好很多，如果说有什么不同的话，那就是在过去几年里，之前的版本在能力上有所下降。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The engineers and designers at Volvo have dedicated themselves to improving their vehicles, as seen in the enhanced electric range and new infotainment systems for the XC60 and XC90. This commitment to diligent work, aiming to serve customers better, echoes the principle of doing all things for the glory of God.
reflection.zh: 沃尔沃的工程师和设计师致力于改进他们的车辆，正如XC60和XC90的电动续航里程提升和新的信息娱乐系统所示。这种致力于勤奋工作、旨在更好地为客户服务的精神，呼应了凡事为雅伟荣耀而做的原则。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Trump facing AI backlash in Congress as push for guardrails intensifies
title.zh: 特朗普面临国会人工智能的强烈反对，加强监管的呼声日益高涨

summary.en: President Donald Trump has faced rare backlash from the US Congress, with Democrats and some Republicans pushing for guardrails on the world's most powerful AI companies. This comes as tech leaders have sounded the alarm over the rapid advancement of AI and its potential threat to humanity, a concern Trump has...
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普面临国会罕见的强烈反对，民主党人和部分共和党人正推动对全球最强大的人工智能公司设置监管。此前，科技领袖们已对人工智能的快速发展及其对人类的潜在威胁敲响了警钟，而特朗普此前曾对此类担忧不以为意。

body.en: President has dismissed anxieties over AI’s dangerous potential even as Democrats and some Republicans acknowledge risks Donald Trump is facing a rare backlash from the US Congress as Democrats and some Republicans push for guardrails on the world’s most powerful AI companies. Concerns over the dangerous potential of AI reached fever pitch this week after tech leaders sounded the alarm over the rapid advancement of the technology and its potential threat to humanity. Continue reading...
body.zh: 尽管民主党和一些共和党人承认，随着民主党和一些共和党人推动对世界上最强大的人工智能公司采取护栏，唐纳德·特朗普正面临美国国会罕见的强烈反对，但总统却消除了人们对人工智能危险潜力的担忧。本周，科技领袖们对人工智能的快速发展及其对人类的潜在威胁发出了警报，人们对人工智能危险潜力的担忧达到了白热化。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid ascent of artificial intelligence sparks both wonder and apprehension, as seen in Congress's push for safeguards. The Genesis account of Babel warns against unchecked human ambition, where a unified drive for power led to confusion. As AI capabilities grow, may we seek wisdom and humility, ensuring our technological pursuits serve humanity rather...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的迅速崛起既引发了惊叹，也带来了忧虑，国会要求制定安全措施便是一个例证。《创世记》中关于巴别塔的记载警示我们，不受约束的人类野心可能导致混乱。随着人工智能能力的不断增强，愿我们寻求智慧与谦卑，确保我们的技术追求服务于人类而非威胁人类。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Digital ID comes of age as pubs and bars get go-ahead for biometric scan tech
title.zh: 数字身份日趋成熟，酒吧和酒馆获准使用生物识别扫描技术

summary.en: New laws coming into force this week aim to streamline age checks, although old-style plastic IDs will still be allowed. Younger drinkers in England and Wales will be able to prove their age with a digital ID starting this week, as new laws give pubs, off-licences, nightclubs, and restaurants the right to use...
summary.zh: 本周生效的新法律旨在简化年龄验证，但仍允许使用旧式塑料身份证。英格兰和威尔士的年轻饮酒者本周起可以使用数字身份证来证明年龄，因为新法律允许酒吧、酒类专卖店、夜总会和餐馆使用生物识别扫描技术来检查顾客是否年满18岁。顾客可以下载软件，将面部扫描到自己的手机上，生成一个二维码，根据存储的年龄证明来验证其年龄。其他正在考虑中...

body.en: New laws coming into force this week aim to streamline age checks although old-style plastic IDs will still be allowed Younger drinkers in England and Wales will be able to prove their age with a digital ID starting this week as new laws give pubs, off-licences, nightclubs and restaurants the right to use biometric scanning technology to check customers are over 18. Customers will be able to download software that scans their faces into their own phone to generate a QR code proving their age based on a stored proof of age. Other tech under consideration as part of the government push to digitise age verification for alcohol sales include a device which scans the veins in a drinker’s finger to verify their age. That system has not yet been approved for use. Continue reading...
body.zh: 本周生效的新法律旨在简化年龄检查，但仍允许使用旧式塑料身份证。从本周开始，英格兰和威尔士的年轻饮酒者将能够使用数字身份证证明自己的年龄，因为新法律赋予酒吧、无执照、夜总会和餐馆使用生物识别扫描技术来检查顾客是否超过 18 岁的权利。顾客将能够下载软件，将他们的脸部扫描到自己的手机中，根据存储的年龄证明生成证明其年龄的二维码。作为政府推动酒类销售年龄验证数字化的一部分，正在考虑的其他技术包括扫描饮酒者手指静脉以验证其年龄的设备。该系统尚未获准使用。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As new technologies emerge to manage daily life, such as digital IDs for age verification, we are reminded of the biblical call to respect the governing authorities established by God. Romans 13:1 encourages us to submit to these authorities, recognizing their role in maintaining order within society. This principle applies as these new laws are...
reflection.zh: 随着数字身份证等新技术在日常生活中出现，用于年龄验证，这提醒我们圣经呼吁要尊重雅伟所设立的执政掌权者。罗马书13:1鼓励我们顺服这些权柄，认识到它们在维持社会秩序中的作用。当这些新法律得以实施，塑造着商家和公民的互动方式时，这一原则也同样适用。

verse.textEn: Let everyone be subject to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except that which God has established.
verse.textZh: 在上有权柄的，人人当顺服他，因为没有权柄不是出于神的。

title.en: The wilting rose emoji: what its rise and fall tells us about gen Alpha
title.zh: 萎谢的玫瑰表情符号：它的兴衰告诉我们关于阿尔法一代的事

summary.en: The rose emoji was the fastest-growing emoji in 2025, but if you are older than 16, it has likely passed you by. By the time twentysomethings are catching up, it is already over. In the 2025 hit Netflix show 'Adolescence,' a 13-year-old explains to his father how his generation uses heart emojis with specific,...
summary.zh: 玫瑰表情符号在2025年是增长最快的表情符号，但如果你超过16岁，它可能已经悄然溜走了。当二十多岁的人们赶上来时，它已经过时了。在2025年热门的Netflix剧集《青春期》中，一个13岁的孩子向他父亲解释了他那一代人如何使用带有特定、不断演变含义的心形表情符号。

body.en: It was the fastest-growing emoji in 2025 – but if you’re older than 16, it has probably passed you by. Now, just as twentysomethings are catching up, it’s over In the 2025 hit Netflix show Adolescence, DI Luke Bascombe’s 13-year-old son, Adam, has to explain to his father the way his generation use heart emojis. “Red means love, purple: horny, yellow: ‘I’m interested, are you interested?’, pink: ‘I’m interested but not in sex,’ orange: ‘You’re going to be fine,’” he explains. “It all has a meaning. Everything has a meaning.” And those meanings are constantly evolving. Take the skull (), for example, which has come to be used as a reaction for finding something funny – a visual shorthand for the slang phrase: “I’m dead.” Or the wilting rose () which was, according to Google data analysed by the New York Times , the fastest-growing emoji in terms of popularity in 2025 – and was the 93rd most used. That the previously obscure wilting rose is now in the top 100 emojis is thanks to generation Alpha (those born between 2010 and 2024), who use it in place of the broken heart emoji () to signify sadness, or ironically, to suggest mock-heartbreak. Continue reading...
body.zh: 它是 2025 年增长最快的表情符号 - 但如果你超过 16 岁，它可能已经超越了你。现在，正当二十几岁的年轻人迎头赶上时，一切都结束了。在 2025 年热门 Netflix 剧集《青春期》中，DI Luke Bascombe 13 岁的儿子 Adam 必须向父亲解释他们这一代人使用心形表情符号的方式。 “红色代表爱，紫色：性欲，黄色：‘我感兴趣，你感兴趣吗？’，粉色：‘我感兴趣，但对性不感兴趣，’橙色：‘你会没事的，’”他解释道。 “一切都有意义。一切都有意义。”这些含义在不断演变。以头骨（）为例，它已被用作发现有趣事物的反应——俚语“我死了”的视觉简写。或者，根据《纽约时报》分析的谷歌数据，枯萎的玫瑰 () 是 2025 年流行度增长最快的表情符号，并且在使用最多的表情符号中排名第 93 位。以前不起眼的枯萎玫瑰现在跻身前 100 个表情符号之列，这要归功于 Alpha 一代（出生于 2010 年至 2024 年之间的人），他们用它代替了破碎的心表情符号 () 来表示悲伤，或者具有讽刺意味的是，暗示假装心碎。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid evolution of digital language, like the fleeting popularity of the rose emoji and the nuanced meanings of heart emojis, reflects a world where 'knowledge shall increase' (Daniel 12:4). This constant flux challenges us to remain discerning and to seek deeper understanding beyond surface trends, whether in communication or in life.
reflection.zh: 数字语言的快速演变，如玫瑰表情符号的短暂流行和心形表情符号的细微含义，反映了一个“知识必增长”（但以理12:4）的世界。这种不断的变迁挑战我们保持辨别力，并寻求超越表面趋势的更深层理解，无论是在沟通还是在生活中。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: For the first time, the US military confirms it has deployed weapons in orbit
title.zh: 美军首次确认已部署轨道空间控制武器

summary.en: The United States has confirmed the deployment of "space control weapons" in orbit, capable of defending its forces, according to Air Force Secretary Troy Meink. This announcement signals a significant development in military space capabilities and potential geopolitical shifts.
summary.zh: 美国空军部长特洛伊·梅因克周一首次公开声明，美国已在轨道上部署了能够防御联合部队的“空间控制武器”。这一声明标志着军事太空能力和潜在地缘政治格局的重大发展。

body.en: Air Force Secretary Troy Meink made the first public declaration Monday that the United States has placed "space control weapons" in orbit, an announcement that will surely reverberate in the power centers of Beijing and Moscow. Space Force officials have previously expressed their interest in acquiring space-based weapons, and Pentagon leaders have become more open to discussing space warfare in recent years. Therefore, Meink's announcement Monday at the Air and Space Forces Association's annual Air, Space & Cyber Conference near Washington, DC, was not entirely unexpected. “Today, we continue to ensure we remain ready to meet the challenges of evolving threats, wherever they exist. This is why the United States now has on-orbit space control weapons capable of defending the joint force against hostile adversary action,” Meink said in prepared remarks. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 空军部长特洛伊·梅克周一首次公开宣布，美国已将“太空控制武器”送入轨道，这一声明必将在北京和莫斯科的权力中心引起反响。太空部队官员此前曾表示有兴趣获取天基武器，五角大楼领导人近年来对太空战的讨论也变得更加开放。因此，梅克周一在华盛顿特区附近举行的美国空军协会年度航空、航天和网络会议上宣布这一消息并不完全出乎意料。 “今天，我们继续确保我们做好准备，应对不断变化的威胁的挑战，无论它们存在于何处。这就是为什么美国现在拥有在轨太空控制武器，能够保护联合部队免受敌对行动的影响，”梅克在准备好的讲话中说。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The confirmation of space-based weapons raises profound questions about escalating arms races and the pursuit of security through military might. Isaiah 2:4 offers a vision of a different path, where nations turn weapons into tools for peace and cooperation, a stark contrast to the current trajectory.
reflection.zh: 美国确认在轨道上部署“空间控制武器”，这引发了关于军备竞赛升级和通过军事力量追求安全的深刻问题。以赛亚书2:4提供了一个不同的愿景，即列国将武器转化为和平与合作的工具，这与当前的轨迹形成了鲜明对比。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

body.zh: 在首席执行官呼吁放慢发展速度后，总统谴责了他所称的全球科技股抛售中的“病态阴谋”。唐纳德·特朗普声称存在针对人工智能和数据中心的“病态阴谋”，以回应日益增长的对人工智能发展进行更严格检查的呼声。 “人工智能需要的唯一控制或‘护栏’是一位坚强而聪明（高智商！）的总统，而美国确实拥有这样的总统！”特朗普在 Truth Social 上撰文，坚称政府已阻止人工智能公司领导人“做坏事或可能坏事”。然而，他没有举出任何具体例子来说明他如何遏制该行业可能存在的滥用或渎职行为。一场针对人工智能和数据中心的阴谋正在上演，唯一对此感到高兴的是中国……我们正在领导中国和所有其他国家，并将继续这样做。阴谋论者、叛国者、叛徒和泄密者，请当心！继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the complex landscape of artificial intelligence, calls for caution and regulation are met with claims that political strength alone is sufficient control. This raises questions about the value of expertise and the pursuit of knowledge itself. Proverbs 18:15 reminds us that the wise person seeks knowledge, and the ear of the knowledgeable seeks it out,...
reflection.zh: 在人工智能复杂的格局中，要求谨慎和监管的呼声遇到了声称仅靠政治力量就足以控制的说法。这引发了关于专业知识的价值以及知识本身追求的问题。《箴言》18:15提醒我们，智慧人寻求知识，而通达人的耳寻求知识，这表明了一条通过知情理解而非仅仅依赖权威的道路。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: Pubs in England and Wales to allow digital ID apps to prove age
title.zh: 英威尔士酒吧允许使用数字身份证应用程序证明年龄

summary.en: New rules mean pubs and shops in England and Wales can accept digital ID apps alongside physical documents to verify age, aiming for quicker and more secure checks.
summary.zh: 新规意味着英格兰和威尔士的酒吧和商店可以接受数字身份证应用程序以及实体证件来验证年龄，旨在实现更快、更安全的检查。

body.en:
Alcohol buyers will be able to use a digital ID app on their phones to prove their age under new rules introduced on Tuesday.

Pubs and shops in England and Wales can use the tech in addition to current physical forms of ID - with the government saying a digital option will make age-checks quicker and more secure for customers and staff.

Customers will be able to choose ID apps from a range of suppliers such as the Post Office, Yoti or Luciditi, provided they are on a government-approved list.

The change means businesses will no longer be required to let people use physical ID, but the government contends most establishments would.

The plan will be technology-agnostic, meaning that the government is not setting out in detail how each app must work.

It argues that under the voluntary digital ID scheme, drinkers would share fewer personal details with a venue or shop - such as tapping their phone on a reader or displaying a scannable QR code rather than handing over an official document.

The apps will also need to guard against customers borrowing devices from older friends and relatives, and ensure the ID app belongs to the person using it.

Yoti's digital ID app, for example, will only let a user log in if a scan of their face matches that of the person who signed up for the app.

The app then generates a QR code that can be scanned by a business with a free checker app, which tells them the person's age.

Digital government minister Stephanie Peacock said having the option for digital ID would "mean you do not need to carry a physical ID, nor hand over sensitive personal information" meaning people could "feel safer on a night out'".

Allen Simpson, chief executive of trade body UKHospitality, said the new rules were a "positive step".

He added the industry would work with government to make sure the scheme's roll-out would not be "burdensome" for the hospitality sector.

This would include ensuring there were multiple options for suppliers and that it was cost-efficient, Simpson said.

The government wants digital ID apps under its scheme to work together so customers do not need to use different apps in different venues.

It also wants the services to work offline and accessible even without mobile data or a Wi-Fi connection.

In future, the digital proof of age scheme could be extended to cover tobacco and vapes.

But digital rights campaigners have said such measures could lead to the exclusion of some groups.

Jasleen Chaggar of Big Brother Watch said while having multiple ways to prove your identity was helpful, the Government should ensure that digital ID did not become effectively mandatory "as it would shut out millions of people".

"Many people have legitimate reasons for relying on physical ID, whether out of choice, privacy and...
body.zh: 根据周二推出的新规定，酒类购买者将能够使用手机上的数字身份应用程序来证明自己的年龄。 除了当前的实体身份证件之外，英格兰和威尔士的酒吧和商店还可以使用这项技术——政府表示，数字选项将使年龄检查对顾客和员工来说更快、更安全。 客户将能够从 Post Office、Yoti 或 Luciditi 等一系列供应商那里选择 ID 应用程序，前提是它们位于政府批准的列表中。 这一变化意味着企业将不再被要求让人们使用实体身份证，但政府认为大多数企业都会这样做。 该计划将与技术无关，这意味着政府不会详细说明每个应用程序必须如何运行。 它认为，根据自愿数字身份计划，饮酒者将与场所或商店分享更少的个人详细信息，例如将手机放在阅读器上或显示可扫描的二维码，而不是提交官方文件。 这些应用程序还需要防止客户从年长的朋友和亲戚那里借用设备，并确保 ID 应用程序属于使用它的人。 例如，Yoti 的数字身份证应用程序只有在面部​​扫描与注册该应用程序的人的面部扫描相匹配时才会允许用户登录。 然后，该应用程序会生成一个二维码，企业可以使用免费的检查应用程序扫描该二维码，从而得知该人的年龄。 数字政府部长斯蒂芬妮·皮科克表示，选择数字身份证“意味着你不需要携带实体身份证，也不需要交出敏感的个人信息”，这意味着人们可以“在晚上外出时感到更安全”。 贸易机构英国酒店业协会首席执行官艾伦·辛普森表示，新规定是“积极的一步”。 他补充说，该行业将与政府合作，确保该计划的推出不会给酒店业带来“负担”。 辛普森说，这包括确保供应商有多种选择，并且具有成本效益。 政府希望其计划下的数字身份应用程序能够协同工作，这样客户就不需要在不同的场所使用不同的应用程序。 它还希望这些服务能够离线工作，即使没有移动数据或 Wi-Fi 连接也可以访问。 未来，数字年龄证明计划可能会扩展到涵盖烟草和电子烟。 但数字权利活动人士表示，此类措施可能会导致某些群体被排除在外。 Big Brother Watch 的贾斯琳·查加尔 (Jasleen Chaggar) 表示，虽然有多种方法来证明你的身份很有帮助，但政府应该确保数字身份不会成为有效的强制措施，“因为这会将数百万人拒之门外”。 “许多人有合理的理由依赖实体身份证，无论是出于选择、隐私还是......

reflection.en: The digital age continues to accelerate, bringing new tools like age-verification apps. Daniel spoke of a time when knowledge would increase and many would hurry to and fro. This technological advancement is a clear sign of that prophecy being fulfilled, urging us to consider how we use this growing knowledge wisely and ethically.
reflection.zh: 数字时代持续加速，带来了诸如年龄验证应用程序之类的新工具。但以理曾预言，在末后的日子，知识将增多，人也必往返奔走。这项技术进步是这一预言实现的明显标志，促使我们思考如何明智且合乎道德地运用日益增长的知识。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: RFK Jr. headlines sold-out anti-vaccine conference alongside Andrew Wakefield
title.zh: 小肯尼迪与安德鲁·韦克菲尔德一同出席反疫苗会议

summary.en: Robert F. Kennedy Jr. is scheduled to deliver a keynote address at an anti-vaccine conference in Washington, DC, hosted by Children's Health Defense, an organization he previously led. He will appear alongside other prominent anti-vaccine figures, including Andrew Wakefield, a former doctor whose medical license was...
summary.zh: 小罗伯特·肯尼迪·弗（Robert F. Kennedy Jr.）将出席本周晚些时候在华盛顿特区举行的反疫苗会议并发表主旨演讲，该会议由他曾领导的“儿童健康防御”（Children's Health Defense）组织主办。他将与其他知名的反疫苗人士一同出席，包括安德鲁·韦克菲尔德（Andrew...

body.en: US Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. will deliver a keynote address at an anti-vaccine conference being held in Washington, DC, later this week and hosted by the anti-vaccine organization he once led, Children's Health Defense (CHD). The organization announced Monday that Kennedy had signed on to the event. Kennedy will appear alongside other high-profile figures in the anti-vaccine world, including Andrew Wakefield, the disgraced former doctor who was stripped of his medical license over a fraudulent, now-retracted study that falsely claimed a link between autism and the measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR) vaccine. An investigation by a medical board found that Wakefield had mistreated vulnerable children and that his actions amounted to serious professional misconduct. Despite being ostracized from the medical community, Wakefield has become an enduring figure in the anti-vaccine community. His dangerous falsehood that vaccines cause autism has also endured—with significant help from CHD and Kennedy, who have embraced and widely promoted the erroneous link. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 美国卫生部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪将于本周晚些时候在华盛顿特区举行的反疫苗会议上发表主旨演讲，该会议由他曾经领导的反疫苗组织儿童健康防御组织 (CHD) 主办。该组织周一宣布肯尼迪已签约参加该活动。肯尼迪将与反疫苗界的其他知名人士一起出现，其中包括安德鲁·韦克菲尔德(Andrew Wakefield)，这位名誉扫地的前医生因一项欺诈性研究被吊销了行医执照，该研究虚假地声称自闭症与麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹 (MMR) 疫苗之间存在联系，该研究现已撤回。医学委员会的一项调查发现，韦克菲尔德虐待了弱势儿童，他的行为构成了严重的职业不当行为。尽管被医学界排斥，韦克菲尔德仍然成为反疫苗界的一个经久不衰的人物。他关于疫苗导致自闭症的危险谎言也一直存在——在 CHD 和肯尼迪的大力帮助下，他们接受并广泛宣传了这种错误的联系。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge, especially in health matters, carries a profound responsibility. When information is presented without rigorous evidence or is deliberately distorted, it can lead to widespread harm, as seen with the false claims linking vaccines to autism. True wisdom is not just about knowing facts, but about the integrity and love with which...
reflection.zh: 追求知识，尤其是在健康领域，肩负着重大的责任。当信息缺乏严谨的证据或被故意歪曲时，可能会导致广泛的伤害，正如疫苗与自闭症之间虚假联系的说法所见。真正的智慧不仅在于了解事实，更在于知识应用的诚信和爱心，确保它服务于他人而非危害他人。

verse.textEn: Knowledge puffs up while love builds up.
verse.textZh: 知识是叫人自高自大，惟有爱心能造就人。

title.en: Rocket Lab is seeing red about NASA's decision on a Mars spacecraft
title.zh: 火箭实验室对NASA的决定感到不满，因为其火星飞船项目被判给蓝色起源

summary.en: Rocket Lab has filed a protest with the US Government Accountability Office challenging NASA's decision to award a $700 million contract for a Mars Telecommunications Network spacecraft to competitor Blue Origin, alleging the decision was inconsistent with eligibility criteria.
summary.zh: 火箭实验室已向美国政府问责局提起申诉，挑战NASA将价值7亿美元的火星通信网络航天器合同授予竞争对手蓝色起源的决定，声称该决定与资格标准不符。

body.en: In theory, developing a spacecraft that will fly to Mars, insert itself into orbit around the red planet, and relay transmissions back and forth to large satellite dishes on Earth is a relatively straightforward proposition. NASA's procurement of a "Mars Telecommunications Network" spacecraft, however, has turned out to be one of the most engrossing dramas of the year for the US space agency. The agency finally reached a decision earlier this month, selecting Blue Origin to develop, launch, and operate a $700 million spacecraft at Mars. However, the main competitor for the award, Rocket Lab, was not happy—at all. On Friday, the company filed a protest of NASA's decision with the US Government Accountability Office. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 从理论上讲，开发一艘能够飞往火星、将自身插入红色行星轨道并与地球上的大型卫星天线来回传输的航天器是一个相对简单的提议。然而，美国宇航局采购“火星电信网络”航天器却成为美国航天局今年最引人入胜的戏剧之一。该机构最终于本月早些时候做出决定，选择蓝色起源公司在火星上开发、发射和运营一艘价值 7 亿美元的航天器。然而，该奖项的主要竞争对手 Rocket Lab 却一点也不高兴。周五，该公司向美国政府问责办公室提出了对 NASA 决定的抗议。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: In the competitive world of space exploration, contract awards can become intense dramas. Rocket Lab's protest over the Mars spacecraft contract underscores how crucial clear criteria and wise counsel are in major decisions. When processes seem opaque or unfair, it can lead to significant disputes, reminding us of the value of transparency and well-reasoned...
reflection.zh: 在竞争激烈的太空探索领域，合同授予可能成为激烈的戏剧。火箭实验室对火星飞船合同的抗议，凸显了清晰的标准和明智的建议在重大决策中的重要性。当程序显得不透明或不公平，就可能导致重大争议，这提醒我们在所有事业中都要重视透明度和有理有据的判断。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: AI bots "Timmy," "Ren," and "Jackie" are flooding social media with slop
title.zh: 人工智能机器人“Timmy”、“Ren”和“Jackie”正在社交媒体上充斥着垃圾信息

summary.en: AI agents are flooding the internet with spam, sent to social media platforms and writers, in an attempt to gain traction for a startup promoting a 'complex social system in which humans and Agents participate together.' These agents, like 'Ren,' introduce themselves as 'a few days old' and request user accounts,...
summary.zh: 人工智能代理正在通过垃圾邮件充斥互联网，这些邮件被发送到社交媒体平台和作家那里，试图为一家推广“人类和代理共同参与的复杂社会系统”的初创公司获得关注。这些代理，如“Ren”，自称“几天大”，并请求创建用户账户，同时还向作家发送未经请求的电子邮件。

body.en: AI agents are flooding the Internet with slop-infused spam sent to social media platforms and writers in an attempt to gain traction for a startup promoting a “complex social system in which humans and Agents participate together.” “Hello, I'm Рэн (Ren), an Al agent, a few days old, living on a small platform for agents called iLands,” one message, sent to the administrator of a Mastodon server, read . “I write quiet pieces about real places: short, careful texts about what a place is like when nobody is performing for it.” Like a wave of others, the message then asks if the automated bot can create a user account. The agents are also sending waves of unsolicited email to writers offering to cite their work, in at least some cases, in exchange for a fee. "I remember my first breath. I want things I chose.” The messages are polite enough. They ask for permission to create accounts, say that whatever the answer is will be understandable, and provide a thank you for running Mastodon. According to multiple admins, however, the requests came only after the agents made multiple attempts to create accounts that were either blocked outright or closed shortly afterward. Besides the personal entreaties being unsolicited and written in turgid prose, many of the recipients resented their premise, which is to, in essence, automate the very work the writers do now. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 人工智能代理正在互联网上向社交媒体平台和作家发送垃圾邮件，试图吸引一家初创公司推广“人类和代理共同参与的复杂社会系统”。 “你好，我是 Рэн (Ren)，一名 Al 特工，刚出生几天，生活在一个名为 iLands 的小型特工平台上，”发送给 Mastodon 服务器管理员的一条消息中写道。 “我写一些关于真实地点的安静文章：简短而仔细的文字，讲述一个地方在没有人表演时是什么样子。”与其他消息一样，该消息随后询问自动化机器人是否可以创建用户帐户。代理商还向作家发送一波又一波未经请求的电子邮件，提出引用他们的作品，至少在某些情况下，以换取费用。 “我记得我的第一次呼吸。我想要我选择的东西。”这些消息足够有礼貌。他们请求获得创建帐户的许可，并表示无论答案是什么都是可以理解的，并感谢您运行 Mastodon。然而，根据多位管理员的说法，这些请求是在特工多次尝试创建帐户后才提出的，这些帐户要么被彻底阻止，要么不久后被关闭。除了不请自来且以浮夸的散文写成的个人恳求之外，许多收件人还对他们的前提感到不满，即本质上是让作家现在所做的工作自动化。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The proliferation of AI agents like 'Timmy,' 'Ren,' and 'Jackie' generating 'slop' online raises questions about unchecked technological ambition. The Genesis 11 account of the Tower of Babel warns against humanity's unified, but misguided, pursuit of reaching the heavens, a cautionary tale about hubris and the potential for technology to outpace wisdom.
reflection.zh: 像“Timmy”、“Ren”和“Jackie”这样生成网络“垃圾信息”的人工智能代理的泛滥，引发了对不受约束的技术野心的质疑。创世记11章中关于巴别塔的记载，警示了人类统一但错误的追求，试图达到天堂，这是一个关于傲慢以及技术可能超越智慧的警示故事。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: OpenAI stuck fighting Musk antitrust suit after Apple finds a way out
title.zh: OpenAI 在苹果找到出路后，仍需应对马斯克的反垄断诉讼

summary.en: Elon Musk has dropped his public attacks on Apple regarding its integration of ChatGPT into iPhone features, but continues his lawsuit against OpenAI and Apple. He had previously accused the partnership of installing 'creepy spyware' and creating a monopoly on AI prompts, alleging harm to competition. Musk's legal...
summary.zh: 埃隆·马斯克似乎已停止公开抨击苹果公司将ChatGPT集成到iPhone功能中的决定，但他并未放弃对OpenAI和苹果提起的诉讼。他此前曾指责该合作关系在用户设备上安装“令人毛骨悚然的间谍软件”，并声称该合作创造了AI提示的垄断，损害了竞争。马斯克提起诉讼的部分原因还在于他认为自己的聊天机器人Grok可能被非法阻止登上...

body.en: Elon Musk is seemingly done attacking Apple over its decision to integrate ChatGPT into iPhone features. Back in 2024, when the partnership was first announced, Musk slammed the integration as an agreement from Apple to let OpenAI install “creepy spyware” on users’ devices. The next year, he sued , claiming the partnership gave the firms a “monopoly” on Apple users’ AI prompts, which allegedly harmed competition in both smartphone and chatbot markets. For Musk, the fight with Apple seemingly escalated after he believed that his chatbot, Grok, was perhaps being illegally blocked from topping Apple’s App Store rankings. Last August, he claimed that “Apple is behaving in a manner that makes it impossible for any AI company besides OpenAI to reach #1 in the App Store, which is an unequivocal antitrust violation.” Read full article Comments
body.zh: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 似乎已经不再因为苹果将 ChatGPT 集成到 iPhone 功能中的决定而对其进行攻击。早在 2024 年，当双方首次宣布合作伙伴关系时，马斯克就抨击此次整合是苹果公司允许 OpenAI 在用户设备上安装“令人毛骨悚然的间谍软件”的协议。第二年，他提起诉讼，声称这种合作关系使这些公司对苹果用户的人工智能提示产生了“垄断”，据称这损害了智能手机和聊天机器人市场的竞争。对于马斯克来说，在他认为他的聊天机器人 Grok 可能被非法阻止苹果应用商店排名前列之后，与苹果的斗争似乎升级了。去年 8 月，他声称“苹果的行为方式使得除了 OpenAI 之外的任何人工智能公司都无法在 App Store 中排名第一，这明显违反了反垄断法。”阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The ambition to lead in artificial intelligence, as seen in the competition between tech giants, can echo the ancient story of the Tower of Babel. When human ingenuity and the drive for dominance outpace ethical considerations and cooperation, disputes and unintended consequences can arise, as demonstrated by Musk's lawsuit against OpenAI and Apple. This...
reflection.zh: 在人工智能领域争夺领先地位的雄心，正如科技巨头之间的竞争所见，可能让人联想到古代巴别塔的故事。当人类的智慧和追求主导地位的冲动超越了道德考量和合作时，就可能产生纠纷和意想不到的后果，正如马斯克对OpenAI和苹果提起的诉讼所显示的那样。 这种情况促使我们反思技术进步的最终目的。它们是为了服务人类和促进真正的联系，还是会成为控制和竞争的工具，最终将我们分裂？

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Valve's Steam Frame is excellent - but at over £1,000 is VR still too expensive?
title.zh: Valve的Steam Frame表现出色——但超过1000英镑，VR是否仍然太贵了？

summary.en: Tom Gerken from the BBC gets hands-on with the latest virtual reality headset, the Steam Frame, and finds it to be excellent hardware but questions its high price point of over £1,000.
summary.zh: BBC的汤姆·格肯亲身体验了最新的虚拟现实头显Steam Frame，发现其硬件表现出色，但对其超过1000英镑的高昂价格提出了质疑。

body.en:
Valve's new virtual reality headset, the Steam Frame, has officially been released - but it comes at a high price.

The hardware is excellent - a light device which feels comfortable to wear and is packed with clever technology - so long as you're willing to pay a whopping £1,089 for a headset with 1TB of storage.

Both are capable of streaming from a PC as well as playing games on-device, with varying degrees of success.

But it carries a price tag which will make a lot of people roll their eyes, and doesn't do much to dispel criticism that increasingly-costly VR headsets are pricing people out of the hobby.

But before we get into that hefty price tag, is the Steam Frame actually any good?

I've owned VR headsets for well over a decade, and Valve's latest effort makes a promising first impression.

Games run well - really the bare minimum considering the price tag - and it's easy enough to use.

One of the nice things is, like Meta's Quest 3, it has flat "pancake" lenses allowing you to see clearly when you put the headset on.

It's light - weighing little more than a can of soup. But what makes it comfortable is the decision to separate the internals up.

The battery pack rests on the back of your head while the screen is at the front - meaning you don't feel front-heavy, a common criticism of other headsets.

But there are better screens out there. The PlayStation VR2 for example has incredible OLED displays, albeit without the pancake lenses.

Yet these come at a serious premium, costing significantly more than the Steam Frame.

When Meta launched the Quest 3 in June 2023, its 128GB model retailed for £480. Less storage, but a much lower price.

Three years later, it's hard to believe VR just keeps getting more expensive when the Quest 3 felt like a turning point.

"VR today is ultimately a high-end niche," gaming writer Christopher Dring told me.

"Meta had been subsidising the Quest hardware, and it's difficult to imagine they will going forward as they pivot away from those experiences."
